There's been a lot of talk about the Heritage Foundation's "Project 2025", Team. It's time for the truth.
Project 2025 is a detailed and specific plan for what the next Republican president could ( or in the eyes of some, should ) do with his power, including the preparation needed to put the plan into action. Organized by the Heritage Foundation, a right-wing, dark money, inside-the-beltway, anti-voting think tank , and advised by more than 100 conservative groups, Project 2025 has put forth a 922-page list of policy recommendations, going agency by agency in the federal government.
This is not an unattainable "wish list" -- this is carefully crafted to be a list of things the next president’s appointees really can do , put together by many people who served in top posts under Trump last time and could well do so again. Basically, it’s an attempt to make the second Trump term way more organized and effective than the first.
This is a good place to mention that Project 2025 is also collecting a database of names of conservatives who have already pledged loyalty to Donald Trump and could easily take jobs in his potential second term, willing to start executing this plan on day one.
Are you ready to help us educate voters across the country about this dangerous and anti-democracy plan? Pitch in $25 or whatever you can now >> [http://secure.actblue.com/donate/ifvap-power?refcode=101924_2&amount=25]
Project 2025 covers a lot of different things, but basically falls into three buckets:
➜ Expanding the power of the president. Various pieces of the plan attempt to consolidate executive branch power in the hands of the president and his political appointees and away from nonpartisan civil service employees and Congress. For example, Donald Trump himself could be directing voter suppression efforts through the Department of Justice.
➜ Long-term conservative policy priorities. Slashing regulations on businesses, especially in regards to the environment. Ending climate change mitigation efforts. Reducing programs to help the poor, like food programs or educational requirements. Eradicating civil rights protections, including access to the ballot and our ability to vote. The list goes on, but if you've heard it from a conservative politician over the last forty years, it's likely in this plan.
➜ An extreme religious agenda. Further federal restrictions on abortion access. New, possibly expansive restrictions on contraception coverage. Outlawing pornography and imprisoning members of that industry. Banning LGBTQ books in libraries. Rolling back or ending LGBTQ programs in schools.
Project 2025 would fundamentally alter just about every aspect of American life . We must make sure every American is aware of what their vote might mean and how this expansive blueprint would truly impact themselves, their friends, and their family before it is time for them to cast a ballot.

name: Josh Harder
subject: What election night will feel like
body:
Let’s make sure we’re ready

| | Peter, Election night is coming up in only 17 days, and I’ve been thinking a lot about what it’s going to feel like. My first thought is: it’s going to be extremely nerve-wracking. This race is so tight and with everything on the line, it’s going to make minutes feel like hours - it’ll be intense watching the results start coming in. I have my hopes up that we will have a good night, but I also remember what it felt like in 2016 when Democrats lost and Trump was elected. We were sad, angry, and confused. I definitely don’t want to feel that way again. We need to put everything we’ve got into winning this election while there’s still time to make a difference. I don’t want to wake up the day after the Election and wish we had done more to secure victory in our toss-up race. **[So I’m asking for your help. Can you chip in to make sure that on Election Night, we know we did everything possible? | | _**A personal message from author Paul Gazelka**_
---
The Response to my new book, _Behind the Veil_ , has been humbling. Sure, it’s great to have people like Newt Gingrich, Vin Weber, and Tim Pawlenty compliment the book. And it’s a thrill to have it be _**Amazon’s #1 new release in Political Leadership.**_ It’s even more heartening, however, to have everyday citizens thank me for writing the book. For having the courage to speak the truth. For being the job referral who says, “Don’t hire Tim Walz.” For demanding leadership that champions respect, empathy, and dedication to the common good. **It is with the encouragement of these citizens that I am hosting a book signing. And I’d like you to be there.** Join us for a lively Q & A session, followed by the book signing. We are meeting in the Committee Room at the Radisson Hotel St. Paul Downtown (right by the Capitol). There will be books for sale or better yet, read it now _**[_**HERE**_](http://links.conservativevictories.com/u/click?_t=8bd8e0acf83e479da35569fff26d4bee&_m=3ae377c8591b4a8384c7cb2b00ccf697&_e=mwT18bs54ehlQS1MoIzk0K0rvfkk-0Ba495LbXzF-_zzSjHSF7vszLryDYi_Y7e0Zftoq9fW_9I0cLYtKa2LmjTVOjAKOsMjtMum8v4548dngZA-jICwpyHYCPw5c_0jcCb3aLFkb4EfUeszDcEvdC4qyRJ0lEtiF842A-Txi-yxwuqfxLlUMULpuLWVkCUjLMGDzOcShyn8b672wXx_UAWYBZgPkiVqf4mL9D4E5blm349K-o4FsAU82pMuMSSHB9Owma6e0dpJt9us98tfvG3d9Yt4VebD07LfyDn2wh4wQqRmlQDOqU7C9s8KsOsSwYpYSArrLhsNmsVCe0cv-cCyDBcTpASGrDH6bjm_6ALLQgXcWTVI4RWx0N-J-_qDuyrC-D0ds7Uk2KZoL9MO31ce61nLE0W-1W5i7BuDJnEc4bNUtFLbpemIDYq0N5Gg1CxJ0KfxgG5gfJROYL6bUeNkckq0lsbmanXjdiwIKTQybR9GWnsE4JWrh6TSOI_Jyw0mY6HPtat_w_ca3q6ZY3lfsbb-cK2-NTF94J_melE%3D)**_ and bring your copy of the book for signing. clean_body: Behind the Veil, OUT NOW!| | | | | | | | SPECIAL BOOK SIGNING EVENT Wednesday, October 23, 2024 5:30 PM – 8:00 PMRadisson Hotel - St. Paul Downtown 161 St Anthony Ave, St Paul, MN 55103 (parking gate code: 876#) | | | A personal message from author Paul Gazelka The Response to my new book, Behind the Veil , has been humbling. Sure, it’s great to have people like Newt Gingrich, Vin Weber, and Tim Pawlenty compliment the book. And it’s a thrill to have it be Amazon’s #1 new release in Political Leadership. It’s even more heartening, however, to have everyday citizens thank me for writing the book. For having the courage to speak the truth. For being the job referral who says, “Don’t hire Tim Walz.” For demanding leadership that champions respect, empathy, and dedication to the common good. It is with the encouragement of these citizens that I am hosting a book signing. And I’d like you to be there. Join us for a lively Q & A session, followed by the book signing. We are meeting in the Committee Room at the Radisson Hotel St. Paul Downtown (right by the Capitol). There will be books for sale or better yet, read it now and bring your copy of the book for signing. I look forward to seeing you on the 23rd! May God bless America, Paul Gazelka P.S., I know not all of you can make it to the book signing. If you on Amazon, I’ll sign it for you, whenever we get a chance to see each other again. | | | | | | | | | | | | | ---|---|---

When I turned 15, I got a job at a local doughnut shop. **It was hard work, but it's what my family needed to make ends meet.**
I'm not the only one who got their start in the doughnut business. When he was a young man, my opponent, Rick Scott, **_bought_** two doughnut shops.

While I was a teen making minimum wage to help keep the lights on at home, Rick Scott was an owner.

**For me, the doughnuts represent a lifeline that helped my family afford rent. ****For Rick Scott, they represent the beginning of his private corporate career.**
I went on to graduate college and become the first South American immigrant ever elected to Congress. Rick Scott went on to oversee the largest Medicare fraud in the nation’s history, amass a fortune of hundreds of millions, and buy a Senate seat.

If you ask me, our differing stories in the doughnut business make the differences between us pretty clear.

body:
I am enclosing a survey on a very urgent matter.

This sponsored message from American Update is on behalf of Hillsdale College

| | | [](https://e.updateforamerica.com/rd/9z2zt90cs1mhufqj8blqnrnjrrt0jhmrk64oa5vrcj0_rp22sh2s8i6eoj4s5i61ob1cdh2bs)

## Do you think that most Americans understand how the Electoral College works and its role in preserving free and representative government?
[YES](https://e.updateforamerica.com/rd/9z2zu9edjg1eg58ia76c7qptguq3ngb00dvsccinrv8_rp22sh2s8i6eoj4s5i61ob1cdh2bs) [NO](https://e.updateforamerica.com/rd/9z2zjtlrpre7ojkgs9qcnobqj2hok50v77obarigl8g_rp22sh2s8i6eoj4s5i61ob1cdh2bs) Dear Fellow American, I am enclosing a survey on a very urgent matter. It will only take a moment of your time, but the topic is vital to our nation's future. A movement is growing, led by progressives--but supported by many well-meaning Americans--to change the way we elect our president. In effect, it seeks to do away with the Electoral College as devised by the Framers of our Constitution. That's why Hillsdale College is conducting a **National Survey on Presidential Selection.** By completing this survey and returning it to me as soon as possible, you will help Hillsdale College more clearly understand the views of mainstream Americans concerning this issue--views we will make available to policymakers and opinion leaders. You can complete the **National Survey on Presidential Selection **by using the link below: **[https://lp.hillsdale.edu/electoral-college-survey](https://e.updateforamerica.com/rd/9z2zn368tffoa4lnbfhd52lhurlocq7jfdsl92b04eg_rp22sh2s8i6eoj4s5i61ob1cdh2bs)** Please represent your state and take the **National Survey on Presidential Selection today**. Thank you for your time and attention--and for your friendship and support of liberty. Warm regards, Larry P. Arnn President, Hillsdale College Pursuing Truth and Defending Liberty Since 1844

Recent polls in Texas and Florida show incumbent Senators **Ted Cruz** and **Rick Scott** in neck-and-neck races against leftwing Democrat challengers with control of the Senate hanging in the balance. Yet, while McConnell’s money machine is pouring cash into some Senate races, it’s conspicuously ignoring these two key states. Everyone knows why. Ted Cruz and Rick Scott are conservative patriots, not leadership lapdogs. They fight for the American people and for the Constitution, which means they often challenge the Beltway Establishment. **[**Please don't sleep on these Senate races. Support Ted Cruz and Rick Scott with a split contribution today.**](https://e.youramerica.news/rd/9z2zfb2evggp9umg1gidjcmbn04eq83blh78dnl0nfo_rp22sh2s8i6eoj4s5h64o36c5h2bs)** **_"Mitch McConnell runs the largest Republican super PAC in the country," said Senator Cruz. "It has $400 million, but that super PAC is used to reward the Republican Senators who obey him and to punish those who dare to stand up to him_."** So while Democrats pump millions into Texas and Florida to turn them blue, Washington Republicans are slow-walking their support — even as these races tighten. With McConnell stepping down as the Republican Leader in November, his decision to abandon conservatives a fitting end to his failed leadership — one last betrayal on his way out the door. name: Hillsdale College via Trump News HQ
subject: The greatest armed conflict in human history
body:
Only a fraction of the 16 million Americans who fought bravely in World War II remain with us.

This sponsored message from Trump Train News is on behalf of Hillsdale College
[](https://e.trumptrainnews.com/rd/9z2zjf5gsip3c1p1fnv8b6k7a6vcns0gkvk2bq6a5ko_rp22sh2s8i6eoj4s5h64o36c5h2bs) Dear Fellow American,
Only a fraction of the 16 million Americans who fought bravely in World War II remain with us. This fact means that we’re losing more and more living memory of the greatest armed conflict in human history, which makes the study of World War II even more important.
To this end, Hillsdale College has produced an online course called **“The Second World Wars.”**
**Taught by historian Victor Davis Hanson** , this course explores how the conflict’s diverse theaters, belligerents, and ways of fighting came eventually to define a single war. And it examines the key investments, strategies, and leaders that led the Allied powers to victory over the Axis. [](https://e.trumptrainnews.com/rd/9z2z64oo2utc8hfo938t6lj6kobhoq97r06imrugq7g_rp22sh2s8i6eoj4s5h64o36c5h2bs) If you’d like to secure a DVD set before they’re all gone, you can get one shipped directly to your home for any gift of $100 or more to Hillsdale College.
Here’s a secure link to reserve your copy of **“The Second World Wars”** on DVD:
**[https://secured.hillsdale.edu/hillsdale/support-the-second-world-wars](https://e.trumptrainnews.com/rd/9z2zeagqrrebs0cbtilt8cutehjoosoodqstgtkqtcg_rp22sh2s8i6eoj4s5h64o36c5h2bs)**
Thank you for preserving liberty for future generations of Americans through education with Hillsdale College!
Best regards,
Jeremiah Regan, Ph.D. Executive Director of Online Learning Hillsdale College

Conservatives can win this race, but we must flood Eric Hovde's campaign with contributions right now.

This illustrates why contributions to candidates are so powerful and why we must get money to Eric Hovde's campaign today. The dollars we collect for him can buy more broadcast media than outside super PACs, which will help him win the

I

Jesus Christ.

truths with a broken world. Together, we will make a difference
and bring people closer to Christ.

Thank you
for standing with us and sharing the gospel of Jesus Christ.

Sharing
the Truth of God's Word,

Dr.
Robert Jeffress

body:
Only a fraction of the 16 million Americans who fought bravely in World War II remain with us.

This sponsored message from Your America is on behalf of Hillsdale College
[](https://e.youramerica.news/rd/9z2zehjckj1p5a22a8frq1s62n68o4sgc91g90hpmso_rp22sh2s8i6eoj4s5h6aor6c1h2bs) Dear Fellow American,
Only a fraction of the 16 million Americans who fought bravely in World War II remain with us. This fact means that we’re losing more and more living memory of the greatest armed conflict in human history, which makes the study of World War II even more important.
To this end, Hillsdale College has produced an online course called **“The Second World Wars.”**
**Taught by historian Victor Davis Hanson** , this course explores how the conflict’s diverse theaters, belligerents, and ways of fighting came eventually to define a single war. And it examines the key investments, strategies, and leaders that led the Allied powers to victory over the Axis. ## Do you think that most Americans understand how the Electoral College works and its role in preserving free and representative government?
[YES](https://post.spmailtechnol.com/f/a/XC4wEjwthU0-4fvzg4-HDg~~/AARclAA~) [NO](https://post.spmailtechnol.com/f/a/XC4wEjwthU0-4fvzg4-HDg~~/AARclAA~) Dear Fellow American, I am enclosing a survey on a very urgent matter. It will only take a moment of your time, but the topic is vital to our nation's future. A movement is growing, led by progressives--but supported by many well-meaning Americans--to change the way we elect our president. In effect, it seeks to do away with the Electoral College as devised by the Framers of our Constitution. That's why Hillsdale College is conducting a **National Survey on Presidential Selection.** By completing this survey and returning it to me as soon as possible, you will help Hillsdale College more clearly understand the views of mainstream Americans concerning this issue--views we will make available to policymakers and opinion leaders. You can complete the **National Survey on Presidential Selection **by using the link below: **[https://lp.hillsdale.edu/electoral-college-survey](https://post.spmailtechnol.com/f/a/XC4wEjwthU0-4fvzg4-HDg~~/AARclAA~)** Please represent your state and take the **National Survey on Presidential Selection today**. Thank you for your time and attention--and for your friendship and support of liberty. Warm regards, Larry P. Arnn President, Hillsdale College Pursuing Truth and Defending Liberty Since 1844

## Do you think that most Americans understand how the Electoral College works and its role in preserving free and representative government?

## Israeli Leader Avoids Drone Strike
Israeli Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu was not harmed by [a drone strike](http://email.editor.jointheflyover.com/c/eJx00L2OpDAQBOCnMZlHdmMGCBxcQjaXXogaaA895x9ke2fE26_YfJNKSvpUqn-P-YHsOT7_YiBbXZpBgZFaSVDzhuzP2TSbdURAbUNW9zAaPQxGNbsdelyGTrvNLV0_tK0bBw1GI93Xset63bC9NK1AaaV6bW6jWbHtDWrVAcLSCqNo45ry7ZU41p2cP9Ob8m1NofF2r_Uoov0jYBIwxfNIpV6VgOmCBUxaXTEKmD4p-01G-hQBE5eM5OWROZAMHLlUynKh-MLAUUaqGE_cv4pckQpmQrmnQLJiflKVycktp0iy1Mz_ScDUZLsdH_aey70XRj0Dsv9ZWX977W3hOwAA__8-uG7x) on his house on Saturday. Netanyahu and his wife were not in their home in the coastal city of Caesarea during the early morning strike. The Israeli military said approximately [55 rockets were fired into Israel](http://email.editor.jointheflyover.com/c/eJx0kLGOszAQhJ_GdEbexYmhcPE3dPnbK9ECS9icsSPsC8o9_YnrrxtpNPNJ38dtuJEEiff_tLEvSxrQoNVgNJphJgnvwVazX5iRm4o9OOwstK011eoBGsILX6aW5qldrmTBNd3CroOldR1U4s83MGjAGAe27uxEjbME5oKEY6Os4VlK2utHklhWXsI7vXivp7RVwa-lPLNq_insFfbHcdTTmCMf-ewV9mdU2M97iqxz2eWT9cjxQZtEHblQfNP6pSXvxEHf6Zt04JFiinqljc5ttfv5eUgIkq9OWXPfSMIvvvyl4-XxJwAA__9Ri2MK) from Lebanon on Saturday as Israel continues to attack targets linked to the Iran-backed Hezbollah group. It is not the first time recently that Netanyahu has come under fire: In September, Israel intercepted a ballistic missile that was headed to Ben Gurion Airport as Netanyahu's plane was landing.
## More Blackouts in Cuba
As Cuba struggled to recover from an island-wide electrical blackout, the system suffered [a second malfunction Saturday](http://email.editor.jointheflyover.com/c/eJx0kLEOnDAQBb_GdEb24jsfhYs0dJc2JVrsBTYyGNnm0P19RKSUaedJT6P59R7fyJH35Sdu5OqcRlBgpFYS1BiQ43c0TXAzEVDXkNMWeqNfL6Oa1c2v3hv_mHptQVs_6TnMPT2VVcGSQWrY3W9agdJKWW3a3njsrEGtHoAwdcIoClxTbn8n3utKc_ymD-XWp62Jbq31KKL7IWAQMFzX1WY6K-Vy7zdJOQYBA26U2WMRMPhzwiIpkq83inLJHKRPMeJRqMhCPu1BVt5I0l45k_Tp3Gv-SlyQd3lxXdNZ5ZEuyvJfDd0LGJrswnFxjFyeVhi1bMjxr2r9X7qPgz8BAAD__4o3cms). More than 10 million people were left without power after the first failure on Friday afternoon. Workers restored some power by Saturday, but the malfunction slowed their progress and the nation experienced a second total blackout. Water supply was also interrupted, as there was [no electricity](http://email.editor.jointheflyover.com/c/eJx0kDFvwyAQRn-NvRHB-WJgYOiSLV07WgccCS02lk0S5d9X7t7x0yc9Pb2v63SlXPJy-6SZXUt1AgkolBQgp0i5vCfso0vMwEPPTmmwqIxB2d9dCBYjJNZ8HnmUZCL54OMYvRrBGNtnd9CUBKmk1ApPFgMNGknJMxD4oUPJMbe6nb5rXtqdU3nXJ2-nUOe-uHtr694NHx1cOrjQuvBrP65jbC2Hwh1cwsOTWOuLN1EfjW4sfKHwUx9NzHnJe-NNmKAQtfcKEyp5TsoMSlszJrJoYzD95uL6yqXkfdQdyttMufxJtP-iPB38BgAA__-VCmKy) to power the pumps. Cuba’s government has blamed unreliable service on aging infrastructure, rising demand and fuel shortages, which were made worse when Hurricane Milton interrupted deliveries.
## "Lieutenant Dan" Lands in Jail
Two hurricanes couldn’t drive the Florida man known as “Lieutenant Dan,” from his makeshift dockside home in Tampa. But [police caught up](http://email.editor.jointheflyover.com/c/eJx0kLGO4yAQQL_G7rBgzBmnoLjGXa690hpgHM-KgAUk3uzXr7L91k96enr_r-sVOXK6_cM72bblFSRooaQAuQbk-Fp1H-xGBDT2ZJWBi1bzrGW_WzONRpEJ5J0HF9Q8X0bvvJG4TQqm0LN925QEqaQ0Sg8X7XE0GpX8Awhu7LSkwC2X4SNzajtt8ZWfVAaf7320e2tH7ca_HSwdLOd5Dlv-THTWN-9gedQOlicXjKJSqtg4JxGZHo0SpiYCJoGlUG0UhMvYhCNON3E8XGQvdsLYdrHjF5YgjhzZU19sOE6OketkOi1vd-T4k9N-2_O08B0AAP__mnxqPA) to Joseph Malinowski on Friday. Malinowski, a 54-year-old amputee, became a TikTok celebrity when he rode out Hurricanes Helene and Milton on his 20-foot sailboat. He refused to leave, even after high winds caused his boat to crash into a wall. Officers warned Malinowski Thursday that he was [creating a health hazard](http://email.editor.jointheflyover.com/c/eJx0kDFvgzAQhX8NbEb2cQnO4KELW7p2RAc-4CpjR8YJyr-vqLp2-6T39PT0fd2HO0mQuHzSxq7MaQANqIxWoAdPEt4D1t7NzMBtzc50cENjLep6dQbw4rVF300zXyxOYEc2yNcRwbC2tbhzzWjQRuvOYHPDidoOyegLEIxthZq9lJSb7ySxrDyHd3pxbqa01cGtpTz2qv2ooK-gP46jieMU-djPvIL-xAr6567-KAg_C0eKRXmKaiGJ7NVMG6ssXuKi1mfOMlHkXY2JiqKceS9nKaQsnlSeIpnuaqyts_OPQ0KQ_dpVqJeNJPw-K_-Zejn4CQAA__9DzGw6) because he did not have a proper sanitation system on his unregistered vessel, police said. He was [charged on Friday](http://email.editor.jointheflyover.com/c/eJx0kLFuhDAQBb_GdEbrxcFQuEhDd2lToj28HL4YjGzrrPv7iPTpnvSkGWm-b_ONfPDH44t2tmWNMwJqqUAizI58eM-6cXZlRu4atsrgqNUwaGg2u9w1M5qxMw4W7Fl1ZuzNYPTQ92pA03h70RQgKACjdDvqhTqjScEHEt47oYGdLzG1z-iPsvEa3vHFqV3i3gS7lXJm0X0KnAROtdZ2ueeDa75-gdM1BU5riMk7kqFIR4d8xsznJncK_og1_7xlof0kSSlxLgKnJll3Vh-Cz70RGh47-fCnLP8leFn8DQAA___-NF3Q) with trespassing and failure to appear in court on previous charges of operating an unregistered vehicle and having no valid driver's license. On Saturday, he remained in jail.

What is their plan, and what does it mean for America?

This sponsored message from Reclaiming American Freedom is on behalf of Hillsdale College
| | | [](http://links.reclamingamericanfreedom.com/u/click?_t=5ec072595b1347f09b4bac0de82ea87d&_m=233cffde67304532958592acd8b6783e&_e=8P1NAx0JmZPDO1tvv5FvMBsLz8OfqG4jVVbXISNwyBx1BH3nI7UDVTCC8u_EA-RJHfzuW6_W1I5yKXSBKxlTXNpCF7oUdAx2Kv0Cfkv3TyESg8wHULUb9GmZMhM0BY_5aO6zcqpf7FnUG_pxy61HcF5KTkOvX8u1jYJBRsyBD50hkyjNOh0t0OFtMKQ73qxJbWHwh2ggYfIdq9-8nRoVYq1vugmHxicB8mieI1-qR5lx45GDg4UWBd54b-nV3tVzrQsOC9r-s3U6bWKdvdnSHhN2lK84ua8K1YebWKoCmZXiW9FYi09udyPOudIBxO0Tuhr1X3LG1eFeHHGMWQJAOwY1MK0nyap0hu_RaMH3qqldU_13bNAu87zmNERwKqKNMWaCdNH5eNLy5T6Qp9NtpQ%3D%3D)

A few years ago, members of the world's elite met at the annual World Economic Forum in Davos, Switzerland, and launched the Great Reset initiative.

What is their plan, and what does it mean for America?

In short, they aim to transform the world economy. As Klaus Schwab--the founder and executive director of the Forum--wrote, "We need a 'Great Reset' of capitalism." If successful, their plan would also have the effect of destroying our American way of life.

This initiative is not merely about economic reform. It is an attempt to impose global rule by so-called experts.

Some social media companies are censoring our efforts to promote a seminar we hosted on the Hillsdale campus that explored the topic of the Great Reset. Fortunately, we can communicate directly with you.

In this seminar, we...
* Consider the idea of the Great Reset and its implications for America.
* Explore how the ideology of "woke capitalism" is infiltrating large corporations.
* Delve into pro-freedom alternatives to this tyrannical plan.

**Sign up now using the secure link below, and we 'll send the Great Reset seminar lectures--absolutely free--directly to your inbox.**

[https://lp.hillsdale.edu/the-great-reset-cca/](http://links.reclamingamericanfreedom.com/u/click?_t=5ec072595b1347f09b4bac0de82ea87d&_m=233cffde67304532958592acd8b6783e&_e=8P1NAx0JmZPDO1tvv5FvMBsLz8OfqG4jVVbXISNwyBx1BH3nI7UDVTCC8u_EA-RJHfzuW6_W1I5yKXSBKxlTXNpCF7oUdAx2Kv0Cfkv3TyESg8wHULUb9GmZMhM0BY_5aO6zcqpf7FnUG_pxy61HcF5KTkOvX8u1jYJBRsyBD50hkyjNOh0t0OFtMKQ73qxJbWHwh2ggYfIdq9-8nRoVYq1vugmHxicB8mieI1-qR5lx45GDg4UWBd54b-nV3tVzxxTUwdaAbVxQVRHkrx-rV9x1GMrRUi6em1nhbGTiv_IVPmZ85Kkcwe2agQKZrB3Ffq98Xo4Yl9pVvu2meHrzsJkPkuRpJnD52ecKG3f3qtCacxPg65BCCNvrwg13JtOZHwj2P29oWsg5gpmc1LehWA%3D%3D)

Don't miss this opportunity to learn lessons that are essential to the defense of American liberty.

Warm regards,

name: Shelby County Republican Party
subject: Shelby County Republican News (Oct 20, 2024)
body:
Hello Shelby County Patriots,

We’re closing in on two weeks until Presidential Election Day 2024.

We’ve got **five requests** as we enter the final stretch!

**Preparedness request** : Know exactly what will be on your ballot before you go vote. There are 76 “different” ballot styles in Shelby County for this election because many small municipalities and jurisdictions have issues that relate only to them and to nobody else in the county. It is best to review “your” sample ballot before you go vote. Let us know if you have trouble downloading your ballot, but it is pretty simple to find at <https://lookup.boe.ohio.gov/vtrapp/shelby/vtrlookup.aspx#>

**Early Vote request** : Please vote early, in-person, at the Board of Elections at 230 East Court Street in Sidney. We are off to a brisk start with early voting, but let’s keep it going. With all the natural and man-made disasters we’ve seen around our nation lately, let’s not gamble that nothing will keep us from the polls on Election Day. Let’s get our votes banked in advance. Nobody knows if someone might purposely try to suppress voter turnout on Election Day. There’s just no telling what people with Trump Derangement Syndrome might do. So please get your vote in early. Early voting hours can be found at <https://www.boe.ohio.gov/shelby/election-info/early-voting-hours/>

**Yard sign request** : We’ve deployed 4,000 Trump/Vance yard signs in Shelby County and as many other signs as we could get our hands on. In the last couple of days before the election, please consider visiting your assigned polling place (list of polling places attached) to see if there are any signs near it and/or on the major roads leading to it. If not, please consider taking the sign(s) out of your yard and moving them to that area. There is no definitive state-wide guidance on where signs can be placed. Please just use your best judgement. Please don’t put signs on private property without property owner permission. Some municipalities have ordinances, so please adhere to those. Right of ways along rural roads are usually fair game. No signs can go within 100 feet of the entrance of any polling place. We don’t want to overwhelm any one location, but it would be nice to at least have a presence near polling locations. And once we win this election, please help us to get all yard signs down around the county. Thanks in advance if you can help!

**FaceBook request** : FaceBook is where we can get mass information out quickly. If you’re on FaceBook, please follow us and check our page often to ensure we don’t get buried in your FB news feed. <https://www.facebook.com/shelbycountyrepublicanparty>

**January Meeting Request** : Our January meeting will feature a speaker from the FORGE Leadership Network as we seek to build the future of the Shelby County Republican Party by preparing our younger generations to lead our county, state, and nation. You won’t want to miss this meeting, especially if you have young conservatives in your life! <https://forgeleadership.org/>

Let’s sprint through the finish line folks!

We have to do our part to make this election “**too big to rig** ”!

Cheers...Dan Cecil, Chairman
(937) 206-2970
[cecilda.usaf@gmail.com](mailto:cecilda.usaf@gmail.com)

Here at NDRC HQ, we all agree on two things:
1. Gerrymandering is cheating.
2. Music keeps us motivated when the going gets tough.

So when Attorney General Holder came up with the idea to send our supporters a playlist of his favorite inspirational songs in honor of the 21st night of September, we knew it’d be a hit. What we _didn’t_ know was just how many of you would write back with the songs that help you stay optimistic and inspire you to keep pushing forward. Here are just a few we’re adding to A.G. Holder’s playlist: | "People Got To Be Free" \- The Rascals
"A Change is Gonna Come" \- Sam Cooke
"Centerfield" \- John Fogerty
"Put A Little Love In Your Heart" \- Jackie DeShannon
"Higher Ground" \- Stevie Wonder
"Dancing in the Streets" \- Martha & The Vandellas
---

And of course, lots of people agreed with the A.G. when it came to Marvin Gaye, Luther Vandross, and Earth, Wind & Fire.
**With just 18 days until Election Day, we’ll all need inspirational music — and each other — to get across the finish line. **
As always, thank you for being a part of this grassroots team.
—Team NDRC

First if you act fast you can [**download the nation’s best Concealed Carry Certification available today**](https://links.nationalgunowner.org/a/1537/click/18844/6374453/eceba8748096c2ff1d01788ca1f3d11d559d133f/563387569efd69f543774e1f3a6282d5ef37023d).

It’s important you download it ASAP as anti-gun groups are trying to get rid of it.

Fortunately, because you can still download a certification for America’s top CCW gun certification from this website. (And you don’t have to leave your house to do it).

Downloading this certification online ensures you encounter:
* **Zero** government red tape (and no exposing your private info to the Feds)...
* **Zero** lines, classroom time or books to read...
* **Zero** gun range time (You don’t even need to fire a gun to [**get this certification**](https://links.nationalgunowner.org/a/1537/click/18844/6374453/eceba8748096c2ff1d01788ca1f3d11d559d133f/563387569efd69f543774e1f3a6282d5ef37023d)).

It’s as simple as visiting this site and answering a few questions (they’re simple). Plus you can complete the entire certification process online.

Download it directly to your phone or computer in as little as 30 minutes.

You don’t even need to own a gun to get this certificate...
that’s why it’s been named America’s #1 Concealed Carry Certificate.

31 states have agreed to accept this certificate so far (it’s simply the closest and easiest path to a semi-nationally recognized certificate that’s available right now).

This certification permit isn’t just a basic concealed carry certification permit either. It’s one of a kind... and is available to you No Matter what state you reside in.

→ But there is one thing you need to know...

Since it is so easy to get this certificate, pro-gun-control lawmakers are aggressively searching for ways to ban access to it.

As such, you’ll need to download your online certificate today... especially since tomorrow this fast-track site could be shut down for good.

If you ever thought about getting a concealed carry certificate here is your chance to carry legally. If you think you know some “gun basics” [**click here and download the certification today**](https://links.nationalgunowner.org/a/1537/click/18844/6374453/eceba8748096c2ff1d01788ca1f3d11d559d133f/563387569efd69f543774e1f3a6282d5ef37023d).

### **1.[Controversy in Delco erupts after election board Dems approve last-minute voting centers](https://broadandliberty.us3.list-manage.com/track/click?u=a45553d37b628a10a8ae35af1&id=7a6dd45621&e=b7b3eddce2)**
_By Todd Shepherd_
Delaware County election board member John McBlain has resigned, accusing the panel of rushing to add three “voter service centers” in deeply Democratic parts of the suburban county, something he said adds a blatant element of unfairness to the county’s election process.

McBlain, the lone Republican on Delaware County’s election board, has been the minority party appointee on the three-member election board since 2021. All members of the election board are appointed by the county council, which has been majority-Democratic since early 2020. A provision in the county’s charter ensures a check on the majority party, however, requiring that at least one member of the election board be a representative of the minority party.

At a special meeting of the election board on Friday, McBlain announced his intention to quit effective at the end of November, saying his decision was due to the board’s approval of three voter service centers in Upper Darby, Chester, and Chester Heights — all three Democratic strongholds.

**Why It Matters**. This action follows a pattern of partisan behavior from the Delco board. Earlier in the year, the county council passed an ordinance that would allow it to reject the minority party’s nomination for the election board. The resolution went further, saying that the county had the “unfettered discretion” to reject as many candidates from the minority party as it liked until it found a suitable candidate.

Council Democrats passed the ordinance in January of 2023. Republicans quickly denounced the move as a power grab. When Republicans [sued](https://broadandliberty.us3.list-manage.com/track/click?u=a45553d37b628a10a8ae35af1&id=c7ace252cc&e=b7b3eddce2) in June, a spokesperson for the council accused Delco Republicans of playing politics. But a judge [ruled](https://broadandliberty.us3.list-manage.com/track/click?u=a45553d37b628a10a8ae35af1&id=fc9ab3340c&e=b7b3eddce2) in December the ordinance was illegal and struck it down.

**Quotable**. “I think this is the Delaware County Democratic Party putting their hand on the scale with these voter services centers to literally get out the vote in highly partisan areas of the county without any consideration of [if] there’s a reason that they didn’t come in and offer it in Marple or Springfield. So I just wasn’t going to be part of it anymore. I’m disgusted with this partisanship showing its head at the 11th hour.” – John McBlain

### **2.[Does anyone want to win this race?](https://broadandliberty.us3.list-manage.com/track/click?u=a45553d37b628a10a8ae35af1&id=7e132fb15a&e=b7b3eddce2)**

_By Andy Bloom_
With about three weeks until Election Day, sometimes it’s debatable how badly either Donald Trump or Kamala Harris wants to win this campaign.
If either candidate is “all in,” it doesn’t show.
Both candidates have avoided unfriendly media outlets. But both have done a couple of things to slightly change that narrative.

**Why It Matters**. We have more polling than ever and it’s closer than any presidential election ever. The polls are much closer than in 2020 when mid-October polling averages showed Joe Biden leading nationally by eight to 10 points. Biden won by 4.4 percent (Yes, Trump did lose, and Biden won), or at the same point in 2016, when Hillary was leading by six or seven points. While Hillary won the popular vote by just over two percentage points, Trump won the Electoral College and the presidency.

No poll shows one candidate with a definite advantage. The polls all have one thing in common: all results are within the margin of error.
Both candidates seem ready to double down on their strategies. Harris has one undeniable advantage: a huge cash advantage. While she claims she’s running a positive, forward-looking campaign. She’s flooding the airwaves with negative ads about Trump. The carpet bombing on every form of media will intensify in the final weeks. That could be the deciding factor.

clean_body: News + editorial to start your week | Broad + Liberty Weekly Reads | | | | | | | Good morning and welcome to Broad + Liberty 's Weekly Reads. and get the best of Broad + Liberty delivered straight to your inbox. | | 1. By Todd Shepherd Delaware County election board member John McBlain has resigned, accusing the panel of rushing to add three “voter service centers” in deeply Democratic parts of the suburban county, something he said adds a blatant element of unfairness to the county’s election process. McBlain, the lone Republican on Delaware County’s election board, has been the minority party appointee on the three-member election board since 2021. All members of the election board are appointed by the county council, which has been majority-Democratic since early 2020. A provision in the county’s charter ensures a check on the majority party, however, requiring that at least one member of the election board be a representative of the minority party. At a special meeting of the election board on Friday, McBlain announced his intention to quit effective at the end of November, saying his decision was due to the board’s approval of three voter service centers in Upper Darby, Chester, and Chester Heights — all three Democratic strongholds. Why It Matters. This action follows a pattern of partisan behavior from the Delco board. Earlier in the year, the county council passed an ordinance that would allow it to reject the minority party’s nomination for the election board. The resolution went further, saying that the county had the “unfettered discretion” to reject as many candidates from the minority party as it liked until it found a suitable candidate. Council Democrats passed the ordinance in January of 2023. Republicans quickly denounced the move as a power grab. When Republicans in June, a spokesperson for the council accused Delco Republicans of playing politics. But a judge in December the ordinance was illegal and struck it down. Quotable. “I think this is the Delaware County Democratic Party putting their hand on the scale with these voter services centers to literally get out the vote in highly partisan areas of the county without any consideration of [if] there’s a reason that they didn’t come in and offer it in Marple or Springfield. So I just wasn’t going to be part of it anymore. I’m disgusted with this partisanship showing its head at the 11th hour.” – John McBlain | | 2. By Andy Bloom With about three weeks until Election Day, sometimes it’s debatable how badly either Donald Trump or Kamala Harris wants to win this campaign. If either candidate is “all in,” it doesn’t show. Both candidates have avoided unfriendly media outlets. But both have done a couple of things to slightly change that narrative. Why It Matters. We have more polling than ever and it’s closer than any presidential election ever. The polls are much closer than in 2020 when mid-October polling averages showed Joe Biden leading nationally by eight to 10 points. Biden won by 4.4 percent (Yes, Trump did lose, and Biden won), or at the same point in 2016, when Hillary was leading by six or seven points. While Hillary won the popular vote by just over two percentage points, Trump won the Electoral College and the presidency. No poll shows one candidate with a definite advantage. The polls all have one thing in common: all results are within the margin of error. Both candidates seem ready to double down on their strategies. Harris has one undeniable advantage: a huge cash advantage. While she claims she’s running a positive, forward-looking campaign. She’s flooding the airwaves with negative ads about Trump. The carpet bombing on every form of media will intensify in the final weeks. That could be the deciding factor. | | 3\. Lightning Round | | 4\. Podcast | | 5\. What we're reading Until the powers that be in the Democratic Party anointed Vice President Kamala Harris as Biden’s successor on the ticket, most of the media coverage of her was about her troubled and tempestuous relationships with everyone who works for her. In times of uncertainty, it's easy to feel overwhelmed by the noise and distractions around us. This year, as the nation's focus is on the election, we are reminded that while much may change, one thing remains steadfast: the unwavering dedication, courage and commitment of our service members.
Whatever is happening in our nation, they continue to stand guard or provide assistance in emergency situations, often far from home and family, embodying the very best of what it means to serve.
And at the USO, we strive to be a source of consistency for the men and women who serve and sacrifice, offering comfort and connection when they need it most. Your support helps us send care packages filled with essentials and reminders of home, bridging the gap between the battlefield and the familiar comforts of everyday life.
**Today, we invite you to take a moment, away from the debates and discussions, to make a tangible difference.**

[ https://act.tammybaldwin.com/go/67?t=1001&akid=4199%2E35263%2E9zy7RH ]TAMMY BALDWIN FOR SENATE

Peter, I have a
personal story I’d like to share with you.

Growing up, I was diagnosed with a serious illness and spent three months
in the hospital.

When I got better, my grandparents, who raised me, wanted to make sure I
was protected in case I got sick again. But they couldn’t find any
insurance policies that would cover me in the future.

Not from any insurer. Not at any price.

That meant my grandparents had to pay for my health care out of pocket,
and they had to make significant sacrifices to do so — all because I had a
pre-existing condition.

I saw my grandparents stay up late at night, worried that I might fall ill
again and that they wouldn't be able to afford my care.

No one should ever have to go through that. But my story is not
unique, Peter, and
I knew they weren’t the only ones. That’s why I got into public service.

I’m one of 133 million Americans who have the label "pre-existing
condition" attached to our care — and before the Affordable Care Act was
passed, many of us could be denied coverage.

Now, insurance companies can no longer discriminate against someone based
on their pre-existing condition. I championed health reform and wrote the
amendment to allow young people to stay on their parent’s insurance plan
up to age 26. And when I meet with young people across Wisconsin, almost
every hand in the room goes up when I ask who is on their parent’s health
insurance.

So, you can imagine my frustration whenever Republicans attack our health
care and threaten protections for folks with pre-existing conditions —
including my opponent Eric Hovde, who called my amendment a “stupid idea”
and said young people on their parent’s health insurance need to “grow up
and move on.”

If Eric Hovde flips this seat and secures the Senate majority for
Republicans, the ACA will be on the chopping block and countless Americans
could find themselves in a place where insurance companies are putting
profits over people.

That’s not right. And that’s why I need your help to defeat him.

Today, we face a new generational challenge. Our system of government is in great peril. The democratic values that make up the very fabric of our nation are under assault and at risk of unraveling.

---
Hello, Peter. This is Ken Burns.
As a filmmaker, I've always been deeply interested in the moments that defined the American spirit — the Civil War, the Great Depression, the Second World War, the Vietnam War, the Civil Rights Movement.
These were inflection points where we were forced to live up to the essential promise of our nation: preserving a democratic system of government that respects the rights and addresses the needs of all its citizens.
As Benjamin Franklin so wisely put it, "A Republic, if you can keep it."
Today, we face a new generational challenge. Our system of government is in great peril. The democratic values that make up the very fabric of our nation are under assault and at risk of unraveling. It has never been more important that we come together to ensure that our republic endures for future generations.
To meet that challenge, we need leaders who understand how important our democracy is and what it truly means to serve. That's why I’m writing to you on behalf of Ruben Gallego. Ruben is the son of immigrant parents, the first in his family to go to college, a Marine veteran, and a father.
His opponent, Kari Lake, attacks our elections at every turn. She sows the very same discord that is tearing our country apart. She is dangerous. Where Ruben would unite us, Kari Lake seeks only division.
We need more people like Ruben serving our country, and it would mean the world to me if you could support his campaign.

subject: How should we elect the president?
body:
I am enclosing a survey on a very urgent matter.

This sponsored message from Old Glory Today is on behalf of Hillsdale College

| | | [](https://post.spmailtechnol.com/f/a/dit1fCzmZ--75WjqbXXrsg~~/AARclAA~)

| |
## Do you think that most Americans understand how the Electoral College works and its role in preserving free and representative government?
[YES](https://post.spmailtechnol.com/f/a/dit1fCzmZ--75WjqbXXrsg~~/AARclAA~) [NO](https://post.spmailtechnol.com/f/a/dit1fCzmZ--75WjqbXXrsg~~/AARclAA~) Dear Fellow American, I am enclosing a survey on a very urgent matter. It will only take a moment of your time, but the topic is vital to our nation's future. A movement is growing, led by progressives--but supported by many well-meaning Americans--to change the way we elect our president. In effect, it seeks to do away with the Electoral College as devised by the Framers of our Constitution. That's why Hillsdale College is conducting a **National Survey on Presidential Selection.** By completing this survey and returning it to me as soon as possible, you will help Hillsdale College more clearly understand the views of mainstream Americans concerning this issue--views we will make available to policymakers and opinion leaders. You can complete the **National Survey on Presidential Selection **by using the link below: **[https://lp.hillsdale.edu/electoral-college-survey](https://post.spmailtechnol.com/f/a/dit1fCzmZ--75WjqbXXrsg~~/AARclAA~)** Please represent your state and take the **National Survey on Presidential Selection today**. Thank you for your time and attention--and for your friendship and support of liberty. Warm regards, Larry P. Arnn President, Hillsdale College Pursuing Truth and Defending Liberty Since 1844
---

The day before the anniversary of the Supreme Court’s disastrous Dobbs decision, I woke up to Fox News and Lauren Boebert attacking my sister and my 81-year-old father.
[](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/95417421/506668614/872526041?nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMzMvMS85NjIxNiIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICI3YTJlMzk5OS1lYjhlLWVmMTEtODQ3NC0wMDBkM2E5OGZhNmIiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=44WuarHMBTosAB-K2Oiu3IUEr37uKp0-sGRH_Eo-Z7Q=&emci=6e11a215-918e-ef11-8474-000d3a98fa6b&emdi=7a2e3999-eb8e-ef11-8474-000d3a98fa6b&ceid=19445147)
[ ](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/95417427/506668625/872526041?nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMzMvMS85NjIxNiIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICI3YTJlMzk5OS1lYjhlLWVmMTEtODQ3NC0wMDBkM2E5OGZhNmIiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=44WuarHMBTosAB-K2Oiu3IUEr37uKp0-sGRH_Eo-Z7Q=&emci=6e11a215-918e-ef11-8474-000d3a98fa6b&emdi=7a2e3999-eb8e-ef11-8474-000d3a98fa6b&ceid=19445147)
Hello,
The day before the anniversary of the Supreme Court’s disastrous _Dobbs_ decision, I woke up to Fox News and Lauren Boebert attacking my sister and my 81-year-old father.
For decades, Dad was an OB-GYN. He delivered thousands of babies and wrote books on how to get pregnant and to navigate menopause. Dad provided women with full access to all kinds of reproductive health care, including abortions, in the years right after _Roe_ – and he has now had to watch as women’s reproductive rights are gutted in the aftermath of _Dobbs_.
Dad and his clinic faced many threats over the years. It’s no exaggeration to say that he put his own safety – and that of his family – at risk in order to protect the rights of women to make their own medical decisions.
But I’m not sure he ever expected to see a sitting member of Congress attacking him – or my sister who followed in his footsteps – in a national news outlet. **It’s disgusting. These kinds of personal attacks against my family have no place in our politics and do nothing to serve the people of Western and Southern Colorado.**
If extremists like Lauren Boebert and my new Republican opponent want to have a conversation about reproductive rights in this country, I am more than happy to have that debate. We can talk about how I support _freedom_ and _liberty_ – and how they support big government intruding into the lives of women. We can talk about how they support a national ban on abortion – with no exceptions for rape, incest, or the life of the mother. And we can talk about how they are so extreme, they even want to ban the pill that’s been used by women for decades.
I am willing to talk all day about the fringe view that the government should be dictating women’s medical decisions. **But what I won’t accept is extremists like Lauren Boebert and Fox News attacking my father and my sister.**
I am _incredibly_ proud of my father. He provided health care to women when they needed it during some of the happiest – and most devastating – moments of their lives. Before retirement, he would drive two hours to Planned Parenthood and help teach the next generation of health care providers, like my sister. And no one – not Fox News, and especially not extremists like Lauren Boebert or my new Republican opponent – is going to stop my family from continuing to stand up for a woman’s right to choose.

body:
Just when I think we’ve raised enough to keep Tammy Baldwin and Chuck Schumer on the defensive in Wisconsin, they tap their megadonors to pour more money into Wisconsin. | Fellow Conservative, I’m starting to lose sleep on this race.

Just when I think we’ve raised enough to keep Tammy Baldwin and Chuck Schumer on the defensive in Wisconsin, they tap their megadonors to pour more money into Wisconsin.

name: Tom Carle
subject: Update 10/20/24
body:
Hey now and Happy Sunday!
Here's hoping all is well with everyone going into these last couple of
weeks before the election! SInce my last update - the former president has
said that 'pets are being eaten' and that 'his Opponents will be chased
down by the US Military', among all else that he rants about! Besides his
election denying, and women's reproductive rights denying, lying about the
economy - have no fears - my opponent is still right in lockstep with him!
He denied knowing about Project 2025 and made an excuse for the former
president, in my debate with him! I am pretty sure that I held him
accountable on this one, and the contrast in our choices could not be more
obvious!

My opponent said that I was obsessed, and had Trump Derangement Syndrome!
It appears to me that he and they are the ones that are deranged about it
all! None of us want Christian Nationalism, Trumpism, Theocracy or
Authoritarianism! We have to stop their movement in this election, because
'We are not going back!'

The great news is that our campaign is gaining momentum on a number of
different fronts! We have some postcarding, phone banking, text banking,
literature dropping combined with door-knocking, and meet and greets, on
the ground level! I seriously thank every one of you that contributes to
the campaign in your own way! It all counts and adds up!

Oh, and signs - we will have distributed 2200 signs across 9 counties by
the end of the week! Great job! I cannot believe it! This Thursday, I am
traveling across the district, if anyone needs signs or has any for me to
pick up, please let me know - and I will give or grab them! I have
approximately 200 more for last minute placings and for election day, 150
ft from polling stations! Once they are all in place that will be 2200!
(and I have a short list of those of you that have requested signs that I
will try to have in place by the end of the week - across the district -
thank you for your patience!)

For much of our outreach we have relied on social media and sharing for
much of our county to county communications, and it has worked well! If
you keep linking to our FB page and share our posts with your contacts you
will provide us with the greatest reach ever! We will also begin boosting
posts through FB for the last 2 weeks as well!

The new dimension to the campaign is the television exposure!
So far, I have been interviewed on WETM channel 18 out of Elmira, with Jim
Turpin, their news director, on the Talk of the Twin Tiers show.

A week later, that same station carried a debate between my opponent and
I! Both shows can be viewed through WETM, and/or Youtube. Here are the
links:

Twin Tiers Interview:
https://www.mytwintiers.com/twin-tiers-features/talk-of-the-tiers/talk-of-the-tiers-tom-carle-d/

Debate:
https://youtu.be/KccSjSj_P98?si=st-DX5OSU7g2kSKw

If you don't want to watch the entire debate, please check out the debate
highlight reel on our Facebook page - it's 7 minutes of the best! You will
know after watching that I will be out here defending democracy, women's
rights, Social Security, veterans and public education, fighting for
solutions to problems and so much more!

This coming week, I will be meeting with Spectrum news, WIVB and WENY for
interviews.

Also, this past week, I have been on Tik Tok and interviewed for a podcast
with Michael Cohen - yes, the ex-president's former 'fixer'! He was very
nice, in his own 'unique way' - so, now we will see if he posts it! This
would take us national, if not, global! Ha!

And, I spoke and answered questions at Western NY Independent Living in
Buffalo, and was interviewed by newspapers in Erie and Niagara County! I
finished the week with a trip to Salamanca to support the candidate for
Sheriff of Cattaraugus County, DJ Whitmore! He is excellent!

Back on the 24th of September we did an evening at the Byrdhouse in Orchard
Park - great hospitality and the wings rivaled any in the area!
The 26th, had a terrific fundraiser for the City of Corning Dems and we
picked up some additional Steuben County support there!
On the 3rd it was a fundraiser for Chemung County Dems and it was 'standing
room only'!
On the 6th of October, I was able to speak at the Park Church on
reproductive care and freedom, and was able to sit-in on their forums
relating to housing, climate and social justice. The congregation and
pastor there are very engaged and trying to make the world a better place!
On the 13th, we had a brunch event at the Rust Belt Restaurant in
Blasdell. The food was terrific and we had plenty of pleasant political
conversations! The supporters in attendance were very generous and we even
had some fun with trivia! The Rust Belt itself was a great venue and we
plan to return there for dinner very soon!

Not to leave anyone out of the mix, I have also attended events in Olean
twice, Democratic committee meetings in Mayville, and Eden, visited the
Campaign offices in Corning, Wellsville and Hornell, and I have met with
the Friends Committee on National Legislation in Orchard Park, filled out a
bazillion surveys, and more!

The last thought that I would like to share, and I am sure that some of you
have heard me say this already ----- "I never knew how many people worked
so hard behind the scenes to keep Democracy alive!" It really is
heartwarming to know and amazing to witness as I travel around the
district! Thank you!

And you know that I am making this run because I care about our collective
future, and like you, I cannot let us be governed by those that would defy
the Constitution, deny an election, create such fraud and spread
disinformation in an attempt to ruin our good nature and fellowship.
Together, we have to stand for our rights, our freedom and the truth!

Let's keep the energy up, the message positive and do our best to bring it
all home!

Because, if they win, America loses!

All the best, all the time! Thank you again, with the highest regards!

Tom
Carle for Congress!

I’m blessed with a beautiful wife, Bonnie, and two amazing children. I’ve lived a life of service, but the greatest honor of my life has been giving back to my community, through serving as Mayor of my hometown, Stockton.

I’m the grandson of Mexican immigrants, and my stepfather is an Army veteran. Like many Stocktonians, my family has overcome economic setbacks. My own father struggled to survive on these streets, and was at one time, homeless. But I never let adversity define me. I joined the Marines and served in the White House Military Office, assigned to Marine One. I graduated college while working full-time and raising a family. I’ve worked in corporate America and served our community as a pastor, and as a non-profit leader. I’m blessed with a beautiful wife, Bonnie, and two amazing children. Friend,
We are at a crossroads, team.
One path, paved with fairness, leads to a future in which everyone is equally represented in our nation’s democracy. The other, paved with political greed and opportunism, promises a future where extremist politicians can bend the rules in their favor to subvert the will of hardworking voters.
While a lot of people pay attention to federal races, you’re on this team because you know that state-level elections — in Minnesota and around the country — will decide the future of voting rights, abortion rights, and even our democracy.
That’s why I'm asking: Will you dig deep and donate to the Minnesota House DFL right now to help elect leaders who will help build a democracy that works for all? [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/hdfl-oct24?refcode=102024holder]
In the final stretch before people cast their ballots, we must make sure voters know what’s at stake in this election. The American people know the importance of preserving and strengthening our democracy, including by fighting gerrymandering — but they need to know that state legislative races play a powerful role in ensuring fair maps and fair elections.
That’s why the National Democratic Redistricting Committee (NDRC) is so proud to partner with the Minnesota House DFL.
Together, we can elect leaders who are committed to upholding American democracy and safeguarding voting rights. That starts with your grassroots donation to the Minnesota House DFL today — pitch in to help power this work. [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/hdfl-oct24?refcode=102024holder]
Thank you,
Eric H. Holder, Jr.,

name: Lucas Tyree Kunce
subject: I’m running to represent real, everyday Missourians in the U.S. Senate
disclaimer_text: Paid for by Lucas Kunce for Missouri
body:
#
Hi Peter, I’m Lucas Kunce — the 13-year Marine veteran, antitrust advocate, and born-and-raised Missourian running to replace Josh Hawley in the U.S. Senate.
This email is long. But I wanted to take a moment today to reintroduce myself and tell you more about the historic opportunity we have to defeat Josh Hawley and take back power for real Missourians in just 16 short days.
**So before I ask you to[add a donation of any amount to my grassroots campaign,](https://act.lucaskunce.com/go/78835?refcode=em20241020-8139&firstname=Peter&lastname=Willis&email=dpwillis67@gmail.com&zip=18326&city=Cresco&state=PA&amounts=5%2C20%2C50%2C100%2C250%2C500%2C1000&t=1&akid=8139%2E614464%2ElQEtCA) please let me explain:**
[](https://act.lucaskunce.com/go/78835?refcode=em20241020-8139&firstname=Peter&lastname=Willis&email=dpwillis67@gmail.com&zip=18326&city=Cresco&state=PA&amounts=5%2C20%2C50%2C100%2C250%2C500%2C1000&t=2&akid=8139%2E614464%2ElQEtCA)
I grew up in mid-Missouri. And like so many other Americans, my family lived paycheck-to-paycheck. So when my little sister was born with a heart condition, the medical bills bankrupted us. Maxed-out credit cards and no money left, times had never been tougher.
But we weren’t alone — our community took care of us. When my parents had to take my sister to the hospital in St. Louis, our neighbors and friends took my siblings and me into their homes and brought more meals by the house than we could ever hope to eat. **That’s the Missouri I grew up in.**
[](https://act.lucaskunce.com/go/78835?refcode=em20241020-8139&firstname=Peter&lastname=Willis&email=dpwillis67@gmail.com&zip=18326&city=Cresco&state=PA&amounts=5%2C20%2C50%2C100%2C250%2C500%2C1000&t=3&akid=8139%2E614464%2ElQEtCA)
Their support helped send me to college, and after that I joined the Marines to honor everything they had done for me and my family growing up. Got deployed to Iraq and Afghanistan. Later the Pentagon. I was on the Joint Staff negotiating arms control agreements with NATO and Russia.
When I came home between tours in Iraq and Afghanistan, one of the hardest things was seeing what was happening back in my old neighborhood. It was a community picked for parts — the local corner store boarded up, my first family house bulldozed to the ground. **Here’s all that’s left of it:**
[](https://act.lucaskunce.com/go/78835?refcode=em20241020-8139&firstname=Peter&lastname=Willis&email=dpwillis67@gmail.com&zip=18326&city=Cresco&state=PA&amounts=5%2C20%2C50%2C100%2C250%2C500%2C1000&t=4&akid=8139%2E614464%2ElQEtCA)
While all of us were risking our lives building up towns like Habbaniyah, Fallujah, and Herat, career politicians like Josh Hawley let our country waste away. They spent trillions on bailouts, tax breaks, and subsidies for the industries that stripped our communities for parts — like Wall Street, Big Pharma, and Big Oil — and then told us they can’t figure out how to invest even a fraction of that into building up our own country and investing in our own people.
**I saw what was happening — and I was ready to fight back.**
So in my final year of active duty, I worked to upend the corporate defense monopolies that leave our country less safe. I also joined an organization that fights corporate monopolies — we took on defense contractors, Big Pharma, Big Tech, Big Ag, Wall Street. The people buying off our politicians and leaving the rest of us behind.
**And now, I’m running for U.S. Senate to replace Josh Hawley and fundamentally change who has power in our country** — so everyday people call the shots, not massive corporations or corrupt politicians. I want to:
* Abolish corporate PACs
* Expose lobbyists writing our laws
* Criminalize war profiteering
* Ban insider trading among members of Congress
* Enact a Marshall Plan for the Midwest — a massive investment and job creation program that will rebuild our forgotten communities and get us off fossil fuels once and for all
* Codify Roe v. Wade
* Secure voting rights
* Ban anti-union “Right-to-Work” scams forever

**I want to put working people in charge of our country and I need your help to get it done.**
**Without a single cent of corporate PAC money, we’ve built this people-powered movement that’s going to defeat Josh Hawley and flip this Senate seat — and I need you in this final stretch.[Please add a donation of any amount right now so we can finally give power back to everyday, working people on November 5th.](https://act.lucaskunce.com/go/78835?refcode=em20241020-8139&firstname=Peter&lastname=Willis&email=dpwillis67@gmail.com&zip=18326&city=Cresco&state=PA&amounts=5%2C20%2C50%2C100%2C250%2C500%2C1000&t=5&akid=8139%2E614464%2ElQEtCA)**
If you've stored your info with ActBlue Express, we'll process your contribution instantly:
[Contribute $10](https://act.lucaskunce.com/go/78836?refcode=em20241020-8139&firstname=Peter&lastname=Willis&email=dpwillis67@gmail.com&zip=18326&city=Cresco&state=PA&amount=10&t=6&akid=8139%2E614464%2ElQEtCA) [Contribute $25](https://act.lucaskunce.com/go/78836?refcode=em20241020-8139&firstname=Peter&lastname=Willis&email=dpwillis67@gmail.com&zip=18326&city=Cresco&state=PA&amount=25&t=7&akid=8139%2E614464%2ElQEtCA) [Contribute $30](https://act.lucaskunce.com/go/78836?refcode=em20241020-8139&firstname=Peter&lastname=Willis&email=dpwillis67@gmail.com&zip=18326&city=Cresco&state=PA&amount=30&t=8&akid=8139%2E614464%2ElQEtCA) [Contribute $50](https://act.lucaskunce.com/go/78836?refcode=em20241020-8139&firstname=Peter&lastname=Willis&email=dpwillis67@gmail.com&zip=18326&city=Cresco&state=PA&amount=50&t=9&akid=8139%2E614464%2ElQEtCA) [Contribute $100](https://act.lucaskunce.com/go/78836?refcode=em20241020-8139&firstname=Peter&lastname=Willis&email=dpwillis67@gmail.com&zip=18326&city=Cresco&state=PA&amount=100&t=10&akid=8139%2E614464%2ElQEtCA) [Contribute $250](https://act.lucaskunce.com/go/78836?refcode=em20241020-8139&firstname=Peter&lastname=Willis&email=dpwillis67@gmail.com&zip=18326&city=Cresco&state=PA&amount=250&t=11&akid=8139%2E614464%2ElQEtCA) [Give another amount](https://act.lucaskunce.com/go/78835?refcode=em20241020-8139&firstname=Peter&lastname=Willis&email=dpwillis67@gmail.com&zip=18326&city=Cresco&state=PA&amounts=5%2C20%2C50%2C100%2C250%2C500%2C1000&t=12&akid=8139%2E614464%2ElQEtCA)
---
I’m not just running to make a point — **this is a race we can win.**
Since Hawley was elected, Missourians have broken with him and taken back their power at the ballot box by voting to raise the minimum wage, expand Medicaid through the Affordable Care Act, and legalize cannabis. **And this year, with an initiative to end Missouri’s extreme abortion ban going on the ballot, we expect even more voters to turn out and protect their freedoms this November.**
**Now, recent polls show that we’ve cut Hawley’s lead to just a few points over a matter of weeks** — and if we’re able to keep communicating to voters that our campaign is about taking back power for real Missourians, I know that we have a real shot at defeating Josh Hawley on November 5th.
**But I need your support to get it done, Peter.** National insiders and even Hawley’s own campaign are spending millions to air false attacks about me — and in the final weeks, they’re bound to get even more vicious. That’s why we need the resources to fight back and deliver our positive message to voters.
**[Will you chip in anything you can right now so we can fight back against false attack ads and continue airing our own positive message to folks across the state? I don’t take a cent from corporate PACs, so I mean it when I say anything makes a big difference to our campaign.](https://act.lucaskunce.com/go/78835?refcode=em20241020-8139&firstname=Peter&lastname=Willis&email=dpwillis67@gmail.com&zip=18326&city=Cresco&state=PA&amounts=5%2C20%2C50%2C100%2C250%2C500%2C1000&t=13&akid=8139%2E614464%2ElQEtCA)**
If you've stored your info with ActBlue Express, we'll process your contribution instantly:
[Contribute $10](https://act.lucaskunce.com/go/78836?refcode=em20241020-8139&firstname=Peter&lastname=Willis&email=dpwillis67@gmail.com&zip=18326&city=Cresco&state=PA&amount=10&t=14&akid=8139%2E614464%2ElQEtCA) [Contribute $25](https://act.lucaskunce.com/go/78836?refcode=em20241020-8139&firstname=Peter&lastname=Willis&email=dpwillis67@gmail.com&zip=18326&city=Cresco&state=PA&amount=25&t=15&akid=8139%2E614464%2ElQEtCA) [Contribute $30](https://act.lucaskunce.com/go/78836?refcode=em20241020-8139&firstname=Peter&lastname=Willis&email=dpwillis67@gmail.com&zip=18326&city=Cresco&state=PA&amount=30&t=16&akid=8139%2E614464%2ElQEtCA) [Contribute $50](https://act.lucaskunce.com/go/78836?refcode=em20241020-8139&firstname=Peter&lastname=Willis&email=dpwillis67@gmail.com&zip=18326&city=Cresco&state=PA&amount=50&t=17&akid=8139%2E614464%2ElQEtCA) [Contribute $100](https://act.lucaskunce.com/go/78836?refcode=em20241020-8139&firstname=Peter&lastname=Willis&email=dpwillis67@gmail.com&zip=18326&city=Cresco&state=PA&amount=100&t=18&akid=8139%2E614464%2ElQEtCA) [Contribute $250](https://act.lucaskunce.com/go/78836?refcode=em20241020-8139&firstname=Peter&lastname=Willis&email=dpwillis67@gmail.com&zip=18326&city=Cresco&state=PA&amount=250&t=19&akid=8139%2E614464%2ElQEtCA) [Give another amount](https://act.lucaskunce.com/go/78835?refcode=em20241020-8139&firstname=Peter&lastname=Willis&email=dpwillis67@gmail.com&zip=18326&city=Cresco&state=PA&amounts=5%2C20%2C50%2C100%2C250%2C500%2C1000&t=20&akid=8139%2E614464%2ElQEtCA)
---
Together, we can take back power from corrupt politicians like Josh Hawley and finally put real, everyday people in charge of our country.
Thanks for helping us get it done,
Lucas Kunce

**[Donate](https://secure.actblue.com/donate/lk-email-footer?refcode=em20241020-8139-footer&t=21&refcode2=8139_614464_lQEtCA&akid=8139%2E614464%2ElQEtCA)**

Friend: When I was growing up, I never could have imagined that I'd run for elected office one day – let alone become the first computer programmer and the first former synagogue president ever elected to the Senate.
As the granddaughter of Jewish immigrants and the daughter of a World War II veteran, I was surrounded by loved ones who taught me the values of hard work, determination, and persistence – and I've carried these with me my entire life.
[](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/95428491/506698070/1399466761?amounts=250,100,50,25,5&refcode=jtk5155-fr-nd&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQNDAvMS84ODI5OCIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICI1NjRkOTlkYi1mODhlLWVmMTEtODQ3NC0wMDBkM2E5OGZhNmIiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=9x7xtid4w5_t2s25gvrYMbtXL43mxSXgIEe3S1OOiAw=)
I carried those values with me when I was working as a cocktail waitress at Caesars Palace to pay for college, becoming the first in my family to graduate. I carried them with me when I was working as a computer programmer in a male-dominated field.
[](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/95428492/506698074/1399466761?amounts=250,100,50,25,5&refcode=jtk5155-fr-nd&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQNDAvMS84ODI5OCIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICI1NjRkOTlkYi1mODhlLWVmMTEtODQ3NC0wMDBkM2E5OGZhNmIiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=9x7xtid4w5_t2s25gvrYMbtXL43mxSXgIEe3S1OOiAw=)
I carried those values with me during my first-ever campaign for Congress in 2016, when I flipped a highly competitive district from red to blue,**and in 2018, when I defeated a Republican incumbent against all odds – becoming the second woman senator in Nevada's history.**
[](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/95428493/506698081/1399466761?amounts=250,100,50,25,5&refcode=jtk5155-fr-nd&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQNDAvMS84ODI5OCIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICI1NjRkOTlkYi1mODhlLWVmMTEtODQ3NC0wMDBkM2E5OGZhNmIiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=9x7xtid4w5_t2s25gvrYMbtXL43mxSXgIEe3S1OOiAw=)
To this day, those values of hard work, determination, and persistence fuel my fight to advocate for working families and bring much-needed progress to the lives of all Nevadans.
**But right now, CNN is calling me one of the most vulnerable woman in the Senate – and _The Cook Political Report_ is calling Nevada the "most perilous" battleground for Democrats.**
The GOP will come after me with everything they've got, and I simply cannot fight back without your grassroots support. **[So please, friend, will you contribute $5 or more today to help me defend my seat and protect our Democratic Senate majority?](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/95428494/506698088/-1820320010?amounts=250,100,50,25,5&amount=5&refcode=jtk5155-fr-nd&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQNDAvMS84ODI5OCIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICI1NjRkOTlkYi1mODhlLWVmMTEtODQ3NC0wMDBkM2E5OGZhNmIiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=9x7xtid4w5_t2s25gvrYMbtXL43mxSXgIEe3S1OOiAw=)**

body:
I won’t overcomplicate this one.
#

Morning, Peter.
I won’t overcomplicate this one. I’m asking you to chip in $5 today.
$5 because we’ve got to reach a bunch of people. Undecided voters, persuadable learners, and even our own supporters who might think they don’t have to show up and vote this year.
$5 because in these final days of the campaign we are funded almost entirely by grassroots donations from people like you.
$5 because we’ve got to hit our goals to accomplish our mission. These aren’t arbitrary numbers. They’re what we need to raise to win.
Winning this race isn’t just about defeating Kari Lake. It’s about more than one seat in Arizona. If we win here we’ve got a shot at defeating Trump in Arizona, too.
Trump said it himself: He needs Arizona to win the presidency, and he needs Kari Lake there with him.
So today, the most important thing you can do — seriously — is make a donation to my campaign.
[**Can I count on you to chip in $5 today? Every dollar, every donation, is going towards reaching the voters we need to turn out and win this race.**](https://act.gallegoforarizona.com/go/1000?c0=ruben-em-oct24.6QErJb&refcode=em241020-2-160&t=1&akid=3396%2E734936%2ExlpchM)

Razor thin margins need a WHOLE lot of support
# [](https://act.leaderswedeserve.com/go/852?refcode=em20241020-1&t=1&akid=1325%2E587540%2ErqpVej)
62 votes, Peter.
Sometimes a race comes down to only 62 votes, like it did for LWD-endorsed candidate Molly Cook.
ER nurse Molly Cook has been a powerful force advocating for abortion rights and public transit in the Texas state Senate. She won a special election to serve out the remainder of the current term, but she’ll need to be **re-elected to a full term in November!**
Flipping a Texas state Senate seat is no small feat. Molly’s race was razor thin, but we were able to flip it thanks to your help. In fact, her GOP opponent even alluded to our “six-figure help” as a big reason why he lost the seat.
Every donation, every show of support, makes a huge difference in the races we endorse. Often the entry points into politics for young people are through seats where an incumbent has gotten too comfy or in the state legislature where our voices have never been heard before.
Breaking through those barriers takes resources that young candidates – just starting out in this field – can not always muster up themselves. Here’s where you come in.
Your $5, $10, or $15 donation is money that a young candidate does not have access to through normal channels. But your support unlocks the ability to reach one extra voter, put up one extra yard sign, or even mail one more postcard to an undecided voter. In some instances, that can mean the difference between winning or losing.

Hi Peter — During a rambling speech at a campaign rally in Scranton, Pennsylvania, Donald Trump attacked wind power, said he doesn’t care about being nice to women, bragged about getting along well with North Korea’s dictator, Kim Jong Un, and _so much more_ for over 80 minutes.

**And he came after me, too, in his unhinged attack.**

[Before I get into the details of Trump’s attack, I’m hoping you can pitch in a split donation between Democracy On The Line and my campaign for Senate — because the last place Donald Trump wants me to be is in the U.S. Senate, where I will hold him and his enablers accountable every single day.](https://click.everyaction.com/k/95430978/506703834/1568742850?amount=10&refcode=DOTL_20241020_EMSPL_E2_T0_AC&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9FQS9FQTAxNS8xLzk0MjI1IiwNCiAgIkRpc3RyaWJ1dGlvblVuaXF1ZUlkIjogImFhNmEwYjU5LWZjOGUtZWYxMS04NDc0LTAwMGQzYTk4ZmE2YiIsDQogICJFbWFpbEFkZHJlc3MiOiAiZHB3aWxsaXM2N0BnbWFpbC5jb20iDQp9&hmac=D9gyzl2RGx8pFJTX6eNH1KjCSs9bPOwTisvRCz6YtVs=) **[](https://click.everyaction.com/k/95430980/506703843/1568742850?amount=10&refcode=DOTL_20241020_EMSPL_E2_T0_AC&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9FQS9FQTAxNS8xLzk0MjI1IiwNCiAgIkRpc3RyaWJ1dGlvblVuaXF1ZUlkIjogImFhNmEwYjU5LWZjOGUtZWYxMS04NDc0LTAwMGQzYTk4ZmE2YiIsDQogICJFbWFpbEFkZHJlc3MiOiAiZHB3aWxsaXM2N0BnbWFpbC5jb20iDQp9&hmac=D9gyzl2RGx8pFJTX6eNH1KjCSs9bPOwTisvRCz6YtVs=)**_“You take a child who is 5 years old, he knows more about Russia than my son, and yet**Adam Shifty Schiff** came out of an Intelligence Committee hearing and said ‘Donald Trump Jr. will go to jail for what he did with Russia’... **It was a scam!**... He’s a **sleazebag** that goes out and says my son will go to jail on a con job he made up with Hillary and some of the others. **How bad do you have to be?**... But we’re going to defeat these radical left lunatics.”_ Peter, there he goes again. Lie after lie. And the worst part is the former president might actually believe them.

As chair of the House Intelligence Committee, I investigated Donald Trump and revealed he (and Don Jr.) sought Russian help in his election, received it, lied about it, and sought to cover it up.

Trump hopes his lies will be a distraction. His insults are meant to take away from the truth — that Donald Trump and his campaign twice sought foreign help to win the presidency.

And when he broke U.S. law by withholding critical aid to Ukraine to extort their leader into helping his campaign, I led his impeachment and secured the first bipartisan Senate vote to convict a U.S. president. He has never let go of that humiliation, so he attacks me. Relentlessly.

He knows that no one has been more effective at holding him accountable for his lies and misdeeds, and nothing infuriates his supporters more than the reminder of how I stood up to him.

In the Senate, I’ll keep fighting his assaults on our democracy and hold his biggest enablers accountable.

His obsession is the highest compliment — it means I’m doing my job.

body:

Friend, every Sunday my mom and I spend the afternoon playing dominoes together. It's our special tradition — and it's one of the most meaningful parts of my life.
[ ](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/95431082/506704167/849749119?amounts=5,25,50,100,250&amount=&refcode=jtk2316-fr-nd&recurring=1&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQNDYvMS8xMDc1MjUiLA0KICAiRGlzdHJpYnV0aW9uVW5pcXVlSWQiOiAiOWVmNjMwNWYtZmM4ZS1lZjExLTg0NzQtMDAwZDNhOThmYTZiIiwNCiAgIkVtYWlsQWRkcmVzcyI6ICJkcHdpbGxpczY3QGdtYWlsLmNvbSINCn0%3D&hmac=W8kKvgLUtgf1e15Bx0dOhT_1EJI7IeJ6YJHQ_D_7ZzA=)
I owe just about everything in my life to my mom. She made the brave decision to move my family from our home in Ecuador to America. It wasn't easy moving to a new country as a 14-year-old, but I can't imagine what it was like for my mom, having to start all over and working double shifts just to pay rent for a one room apartment.
But friend, my mom never wavered once. **Her constant reassurance, work ethic, and firm belief in the American dream inspired me to fight for a better life.**
I studied hard, got a minimum wage job, and earned scholarships to pay for college. After school, I found a career giving back to my community through public service, eventually becoming the first South American immigrant elected to Congress. I've found purpose in my life, become part of a unique community, and raised a beautiful family.
**Because of my mom's sacrifices, my family got our American dream. And now, it's both a privilege and a joy to be my mom's caretaker, ensuring that she can age with dignity and comfort.** There are a lot of big things that come along with that job — managing her doctor's appointments, advocating for her care, and navigating the all-too-complicated Medicare and Social Security systems.
But it's the little parts of caring for my mom — playing our weekly domino games, cooking a big dinner for her, taking her on trips to her favorite places — that matter most to me.

Friend --
If you were not able to catch my final debate with my opponent, there is one moment in particular that stuck out to me.
In an exchange on public education, my opponent, Mike Rogers, said he’s “not sure” how Betsy DeVos “has anything to do with us trying to improve education for our kids.”
As Michiganders know, for decades the DeVos family’s #1 issue has been weakening Michigan's, and the country's, public education system. Betsy DeVos used Michigan as her petri dish before becoming Trump’s Secretary of Education — and she is rumored to be Trump’s likely pick if he wins again.
So yes, Betsy DeVos has *everything* to do with public education.
And DeVos’s connections with our opponent run deep. Rogers' first FEC report of his Senate campaign was filled with donations from a bunch of members of the DeVos family — contributions totaling $46,200 all made on one single day. DeVos has even campaigned with our opponent.
They are certainly not done with their support of my opponent. If all goes in their favor, Rogers and DeVos will return to DC hand in hand.
