I’ve been crisscrossing the country over the last couple of weeks to rally voters, raise funds, and organize support for Vice President Kamala Harris and JanePAC’s incredible slate of down-ballot climate champions. I want to tell you about one of my stops in Washington state, but first, I need to ask for your support. With just 16 days until Election Day — and extremely close races at every level of the ballot — we can’t afford to slow down! **[Can you chip in a few dollars right now to help us keep up the momentum and elect climate champions at every level of government on November 5th?](https://click.everyaction.com/k/95435799/506716112/2105508926?refcode=ea.cb724686-018f-ef11-8474-000d3a98fa6b&ms=ea.cb724686-018f-ef11-8474-000d3a98fa6b&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9FQS9FQTAxNi8xLzk2NzgyIiwNCiAgIkRpc3RyaWJ1dGlvblVuaXF1ZUlkIjogImNiNzI0Njg2LTAxOGYtZWYxMS04NDc0LTAwMGQzYTk4ZmE2YiIsDQogICJFbWFpbEFkZHJlc3MiOiAiZHB3aWxsaXM2N0BnbWFpbC5jb20iDQp9&hmac=4CY01VHlqNMa_-r71qRsBBNZG1VRQiCXSXO-r97Xq2Q=)** The road has taken me to some beautiful places, and last week, it brought me to Washington state. Now, if you’ve never been, let me tell you: It’s home to some of the most _breathtaking_ natural beauty in the world — but it’s under threat by a Big Oil-backed initiative on the ballot this year, Initiative 2117. I knew I had to join the fight to stop it. When I walked into the Green Lake Community Center to meet a packed room of volunteers, I could feel the energy bouncing off the walls. Everyone in that room was focused on one goal: **defeating I-2117.** [](https://click.everyaction.com/k/95435800/506716113/2105508926?refcode=ea.cb724686-018f-ef11-8474-000d3a98fa6b&ms=ea.cb724686-018f-ef11-8474-000d3a98fa6b&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9FQS9FQTAxNi8xLzk2NzgyIiwNCiAgIkRpc3RyaWJ1dGlvblVuaXF1ZUlkIjogImNiNzI0Njg2LTAxOGYtZWYxMS04NDc0LTAwMGQzYTk4ZmE2YiIsDQogICJFbWFpbEFkZHJlc3MiOiAiZHB3aWxsaXM2N0BnbWFpbC5jb20iDQp9&hmac=4CY01VHlqNMa_-r71qRsBBNZG1VRQiCXSXO-r97Xq2Q=) _**Credit: KUOW Photo/ Casey Martin**_ If successful, this anti-climate initiative, funded by a rich hedge-fund manager, would repeal Washington’s Climate Commitment Act that will reduce harmful air pollution, create jobs, and support Tribal communities in the state. This vital law ensures polluters are held accountable and funds clean energy projects and pollution reduction efforts. If I-2117 passes, it would strip away that funding, leaving communities vulnerable to increased emissions, dirtier air, and dangerous levels of pollution. I’ve seen this story before. In my home state of California, Big Oil was planning to put a referendum on the ballot that would overturn a law that protected communities from toxic oil drilling near schools and homes. Now, they’re trying to pull the same stunt in Washington. But we fought back, we organized, and we won — Big Oil DROPPED the CA referendum right before the deadline! **We’ve beaten them before, and we can beat them again. In Washington state. In California. In Michigan, Arizona, and Pennsylvania. Everywhere we fight, we can win.** But we only have 16 days left until Election Day, and we need to give it everything we’ve got. **[If you can, please chip in a few dollars right now to help us power this movement — every dollar helps us reach more voters, knock on more doors, and curb Big Oil’s dangerous influence on our government.](https://click.everyaction.com/k/95435801/506716114/2105508926?refcode=ea.cb724686-018f-ef11-8474-000d3a98fa6b&ms=ea.cb724686-018f-ef11-8474-000d3a98fa6b&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9FQS9FQTAxNi8xLzk2NzgyIiwNCiAgIkRpc3RyaWJ1dGlvblVuaXF1ZUlkIjogImNiNzI0Njg2LTAxOGYtZWYxMS04NDc0LTAwMGQzYTk4ZmE2YiIsDQogICJFbWFpbEFkZHJlc3MiOiAiZHB3aWxsaXM2N0BnbWFpbC5jb20iDQp9&hmac=4CY01VHlqNMa_-r71qRsBBNZG1VRQiCXSXO-r97Xq2Q=)** _If you've saved your payment information with ActBlue Express, your donation will go through immediately:_ | [**DONATE $5**](https://click.everyaction.com/k/95435802/506716115/2105508926?express_lane=true&amount=5&refcode=ea.cb724686-018f-ef11-8474-000d3a98fa6b&ms=ea.cb724686-018f-ef11-8474-000d3a98fa6b&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9FQS9FQTAxNi8xLzk2NzgyIiwNCiAgIkRpc3RyaWJ1dGlvblVuaXF1ZUlkIjogImNiNzI0Njg2LTAxOGYtZWYxMS04NDc0LTAwMGQzYTk4ZmE2YiIsDQogICJFbWFpbEFkZHJlc3MiOiAiZHB3aWxsaXM2N0BnbWFpbC5jb20iDQp9&hmac=4CY01VHlqNMa_-r71qRsBBNZG1VRQiCXSXO-r97Xq2Q=) | [**DONATE $25**](https://click.everyaction.com/k/95435803/506716116/2105508926?express_lane=true&amount=25&refcode=ea.cb724686-018f-ef11-8474-000d3a98fa6b&ms=ea.cb724686-018f-ef11-8474-000d3a98fa6b&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9FQS9FQTAxNi8xLzk2NzgyIiwNCiAgIkRpc3RyaWJ1dGlvblVuaXF1ZUlkIjogImNiNzI0Njg2LTAxOGYtZWYxMS04NDc0LTAwMGQzYTk4ZmE2YiIsDQogICJFbWFpbEFkZHJlc3MiOiAiZHB3aWxsaXM2N0BnbWFpbC5jb20iDQp9&hmac=4CY01VHlqNMa_-r71qRsBBNZG1VRQiCXSXO-r97Xq2Q=)

name: Pramila Jayapal
subject: MAGA Republicans want LGBTQ+ people to be invisible
disclaimer_text: Paid for by Pramila for Congress
body:
We’re not going to stand by and watch without a fight.
# [](https://act.pramilaforcongress.com/go/892?refcode=em20241020-4421-footer&t=1&akid=4421%2E420207%2EQEBUrX)
Peter,
As Chair of the Congressional Progressive Caucus, as co-chair of the Transgender Equality Task Force, and as a human being who believes in simple decency, I was sickened to see MAGA Republicans insert anti-LGBTQ+ language into our annual defense bill in order to try and score political points at the expense of others.
They want to restrict trans service members from receiving the health care they need, they want to ban pride flags from military bases, and more. It’s exactly the kind of thing Donald Trump tried to do as president, and it’s what we can expect if he wins again this November.
It’s an overt attack on the freedoms and equality LGBTQ+ people have worked so hard to achieve in recent decades. Donald Trump and his MAGA Republicans want gay and trans people to disappear from public life, and they’re attempting to use the law as a weapon to make that happen.
But we’re not going to stand by and watch without a fight. Now that the Senate is getting ready to take up the package, I signed a letter with more than 160 House Democrats demanding that they remove the anti-LGBTQ+ language from the bill. And today I’m asking you to add your name as well.
[**Peter, will you sign on to my petition calling on Senate Democrats to stand up for equality and remove MAGA’s hateful anti-LGBTQ+ amendments from the defense bill?**](https://act.pramilaforcongress.com/signup/antimaga-lgbtq-protect-em20241020?source=em20241020&akid=4421%2E420207%2EQEBUrX)

name: Ernest Lineberger
subject: Update from Lineberger for US Congress – October 20th, 2024
body:
Hi Friends of Lineberger for US Congress!

First, the big news!
DFW papers are helping us get our word out by printing various
articles about our race! More and more people are learning that they have
a Better Choice!
The Dallas Morning News Editorial Board *recommended voters
choose me in this race*!!! Not only did they present my history, goals and
message, they came out and said that I am the candidate they recommend in
this race and why! This is a big boost.

October 21st marks the start of early voting. November 5th is election
day!
*Make sure you and your circle have your plan to vote!*

*https://www.votedenton.gov/ <https://www.votedenton.gov/> or You can type
‘votedenton.gov <http://votedenton.gov>’ to get to the website.
To see your sample ballot (Print it, and bring it in for a reference)
To see voting locations, 54 early voting locations in Denton
County If you wait for November 5th, You must vote
only at you allocated location (check this website)*

*Early voting times:*

*October (octubre) 21 - 26 Monday - Saturday (lunes – sábado)
7:00 a.m. – 7:00 p.m. October (octubre) 27 Sunday (domingo)
11:00 a.m. – 5:00 p.m. October (octubre) 28
– November (noviembre) 1 Monday - Friday (lunes – viernes) 7:00 a.m. – 7:00
p.m.*

*I was going to make a list of Democratic Candidates for you, but it is
easier than that!!! All of my recommended candidates have DEM
after their name. It is as easy as that.*

*Starting tomorrow – for 12 straight days – Early voting Do
it! Encourage your like-minded family and friends to do
it! I’ll be doing a variety of poll greeting, block walking, phone banking
and more to keep getting my message out and asking for votes.*

*Our Digital Ads continue to run on a variety of media to get my name
around the district.*

*We put extra money into texting to help convince persuadable voters to
vote for me.*

*Our postcards are winding their way through the mail and into the hearts
and minds of persuadable voters.*

*If you would like to help, poll greeting is great. Just go to your
nearest polling location, bring one of my yard signs with you and sit or
stand just outside the 100-foot line. Be pleasant and show your support.
There are many ways to do it, but no wrong way as long as you are pleasant
and friendly (regardless of any provocation). Remember, many REP’s are
saying DEM’s are demons. We need to make sure we prove them wrong, not
right. So, be super polite. *

*Shirts**; We still have some Lineberger light blue T-shirts left. Perfect
for Poll Greeters, Door knockers, etc. Inventory now is S - 2, L – 12, XL
– 6. No charge, just wear with pride and share the message.*

*Signs, Signs, Signs*
*; Signs at the polling location! Thanks to everyone participating in this
effort. The signup genius is nearly full. Let me know if you need signs –
OR IF YOU HAVE EXTRA SIGNS – I have 42 left. So, 650 are out there
somewhere. If they aren’t where they can be seen, it’s time to put them
out. Also, some of the signs placed out on the roads have been taken down
or have fallen down. If you could make a quick drive by where you placed
your signs to make sure they are still up, that would be appreciated. *Sign
Volunteers: Lineberger for US Congress - Polling Location Sign Placement
and Pickup (signupgenius.com)
<https://www.signupgenius.com/go/10C0B4BAAAD2FA1FACF8-51480094-lineberger#/>

*Social media Support needed sharing the message*; Share – Share –
Share!!! Liking and commenting is good, but it doesn’t add more people to
the post like sharing. You don’t have to wait for a new post. Go find an
old one you liked and share that to your circle of influence. Maybe the
one about being recommended by The Dallas Morning News!

*All of this to try to reach our 300,000-vote win number.*
Hopefully, after seeing my name in a few places, more people will reach
out to you and us for those healthy, convincing conversations that reassure
people that we are for real. *When that opportunity comes your way, make
it count*!

Here is what’s coming up soon, plus major events up to the election.

*Monday, Oct 21st*, 7 am, Early Voting Begins!!! - *Poll Greeting daily
(Will need lots of help to staff the major polling sites) *

*Tuesday, Oct 22nd*, 5:30 pm, Sisterhood for Democracy: 2024 Candidate
Conversations
Tarrant County College – Northeast Campus, Hurst TX

*Saturday, Oct 26th*, Block Walking – TBD When and Where

*Thursday, Oct 31st*, Halloween

*Friday, Nov 1st*, 7 pm, Early Voting Ends

*Sunday, Nov 3rd*, 3 am, Daylight Savings Time Ends – Fall Back (in bed for
one more hour of sleep)

*Saturday, Nov 2nd*, 11 am, Denton Women’s March – followed by block
walking TBD

*Tuesday, Nov 5th*, 7 am – 7 pm, Election Day – Poll Greeting (Will need
even more help with even more polling sites)

*Tuesday, Nov 5th*, Election Night Watch Party, Union Bear Brewing Company,
215 S Bell Ave, Denton
Mobilize link to sign up and details:
https://www.mobilize.us/dentondemocrats/event/670137/

*Wednesday, Nov 6th*, Begin Post Election Life – To Be Determined

*Saturday, Nov 9th*, 9 am, Speak at Little Elm Veterans Day Event
McCord Park, 1900 FM 423, Little Elm, TX

To donate, just go to the regular donation link on the campaign website,
https://www.linebergerforuscongress.com/.
Our Digital Ad campaign is alive and well on C-TV, Meta, YouTube and much
more. Plus, we are doing some amount of direct texting. Your
contributions at this point will be helping us to expand this program to
extend our reach to the many voters we were not able to touch in person.
It’s cost efficient and really reaching lots of people.

Everything you do to support us in our efforts to get our message out,
support our campaign financially, and your own personal efforts to share
our message are making a difference. Thank you!

Giving Voters a Better Choice and Hope for a Better Future!

Ernest Lineberger

Your Democratic Nominee for US House for TX CD26.

It’s cost efficient and really reaching lots of people. Everything you do to support us in our efforts to get our message out, support our campaign financially, and your own personal efforts to share our message are making a difference. Thank you! Friend, Our neighbors are watching their loved ones being slaughtered in Lebanon and Palestine with U.S. tax dollars and weapons. With our government’s help, Israel’s government is committing war crimes and crimes against humanity including burning people alive, bombing hospitals, starving people, and killing aid workers. Since last October, our government has sent $18 billion to fund the ethnic cleansing and extermination of Palestinians. And each year Congress overwhelmingly passes yet another record-breaking military budget—this year it topped $886 billion, with half of that lining the pockets of military contractors.**** This budget is impossible to justify when our neighbors are struggling to put food on the table, fighting to keep a roof over their heads, and rationing their medication. Why do we always have money for war, but not enough to feed the poor, as Tupac Shakur wrote decades ago? Part of the problem is the **deep ties between lawmakers and the weapons industry**. The organization Corporate Accountability explains: _“The [weapons] industry employed 858 lobbyists in 2022—more than one for every member of Congress.”_ 1 Most Secretaries of Defense come directly from this industry, which has spent $250 million on lobbying and $56 million in direct campaign donations between 2022 and 2024. **Corporations like Raytheon, Boeing, and Lockheed Martin spend millions to re-elect Congresspeople who serve on committees that determine military funding.** Many of those same members of Congress and their spouses also invest directly in weapons contractor stocks, so when they vote to send more bombs or send our loved ones to war, they profit personally. That’s why I introduced the _Stop Politicians Profiting from War Act_. [**Please add your name if you agree: Lawmakers should not be profiting financially when they vote to support wars and weapons manufacturing. It’s time to ban members of Congress from investing in weapons contractors.**](https://click.actionnetwork.org/ss/c/u001.qUXRBnqZ7T8nxbpAcIVwoUsWLkUMWlo_0JmZttSlm3-inXg7XQKmpx2SINKyl6WQz_vkJ3ZJKcUzkkSwqwfKGXt3VH5qTBQjGdXvOaiu8j2XRnJuMeXeVCXynWCoOYsun031SfmIlExmMgL2qhGxXqPlbYhw233FWmp6CNpysaVvRDR_QWX8BgyzKrQONodXWGO7MChNk_A6DiKYayx0kOWJ6DBPjs0FSNj8OnbN8to3rpbZJVcLOPwxyEWLqUUHh2BGSZlT_8PDHwXYAWWypwP3BhzNLqoDaLvVTW3vRvqfZrkKHahB2J-3tvzRpQgewKbWMGsxR5GHIkIF45z6BRisI1PD3AnQWUXFE-B3quPXF3F3Ki5XLfdceXNgc4iT2HB3qx7f5xQ4xWY5H1CxAehDqACqlOj-vlfTYqvH5PkHIkWmSgfv408noI79QxXRYgh3alHt-RhA1vzWaeznf2SzbUK9Gox3WD8KRJktKWBh7b_FLnJsIRwSs9HDBXmyQeWDOZl8YV8rvE8mwY1_wBoRQa-3pfaqjh01iiNAQD7IiYqEmgSKSWbbULzkAfOqlRqkLfsah5MTs4QytUquThnJrIqNFEsY0bDHs7CprMHGbwGKvpJB6DThRYC62uQdd6YpC_dkw4SpOktF1ULxBQ/4ar/v9jNdBacTEutznMf3oFhQw/h1/h001.-98IWVbf09Knc3CMHR-lwHbPaalDQ-KcsBgB8dK5PfY) | [ADD YOUR NAME](https://click.actionnetwork.org/ss/c/u001.qUXRBnqZ7T8nxbpAcIVwoUsWLkUMWlo_0JmZttSlm3-inXg7XQKmpx2SINKyl6WQz_vkJ3ZJKcUzkkSwqwfKGXt3VH5qTBQjGdXvOaiu8j2XRnJuMeXeVCXynWCoOYsun031SfmIlExmMgL2qhGxXqEW5Bh4e4C5lLCzaep5Kc6wej3SEvzPZRU8VsCd9mwiiM5z6ZNUMSX67yF_0t_9fNpY5xaZYHkIujpQkWYnVfLdT_z_-DqWPS__q7WXCO-WgLU6BXx-CLMI0P8LJMpcnyJpXf94tKvEZIPkydX-rX4ZoAQDeA5GQR1_dhfYw3rCgcve6hitFCzh6HeePXHTx321ATNhF_zmq8MXqwRsEuSPbs2GBZqqc65eTvVNSUyYMZtfxfQ2OrK-_uLF5L8xStLTWtJMcZkK8tJbLK7HODS2oL7Lb2jg8aN2DQrtrr6JhjvnOXUhfErXPOblYP1V7zZfOmGS-Y3X9muCjvllGt9wfthPu-p4RNrRJp3AdUpeFjtUrMFc-y4oMv7ScCjuT3NpbY69K-I_zScjRjVGrXx7PfWCQWay-1RnLY_Mce3eK0t0COmOQTW6Kri9O3yZgyToEfhdeIgOazf59QWvVsoyE-P0K0kNBrp9sTDkALxD2jJ1DFuV89k57M5txQ_tGQ/4ar/v9jNdBacTEutznMf3oFhQw/h2/h001.DeGVojhSXNudS7dDhTTXV5NK1M6yus2xJaBiGSa6f1o)

It’s shameful that my colleagues continue to funnel billions of U.S. tax dollars to the very same military contractors that many of them are invested in and taking campaign donations from.
If passed, the _Stop Politicians Profiting from War Act_ will prohibit members of Congress, their spouses, and their dependent children from having any financial interests in corporations that do business with the U.S. Department of Defense—including banning members from trading defense stocks.
**Members of Congress were elected to serve the public, not to serve their stock portfolios. They shouldn’t be able to use their positions of power to get rich while voting to pass more funding to bomb innocent civilians.**
Unfortunately, the weapons industry exerts incredible influence not just in our political system, but also in our education system. clean_body: | | | Friend, Our neighbors are watching their loved ones being slaughtered in Lebanon and Palestine with U.S. tax dollars and weapons. With our government’s help, Israel’s government is committing war crimes and crimes against humanity including burning people alive, bombing hospitals, starving people, and killing aid workers. Since last October, our government has sent $18 billion to fund the ethnic cleansing and extermination of Palestinians. And each year Congress overwhelmingly passes yet another record-breaking military budget—this year it topped $886 billion, with half of that lining the pockets of military contractors.** This budget is impossible to justify when our neighbors are struggling to put food on the table, fighting to keep a roof over their heads, and rationing their medication. Why do we always have money for war, but not enough to feed the poor, as Tupac Shakur wrote decades ago? Part of the problem is the deep ties between lawmakers and the weapons industry. The organization Corporate Accountability explains: “The [weapons] industry employed 858 lobbyists in 2022—more than one for every member of Congress.” 1 Most Secretaries of Defense come directly from this industry, which has spent $250 million on lobbying and $56 million in direct campaign donations between 2022 and 2024. Corporations like Raytheon, Boeing, and Lockheed Martin spend millions to re-elect Congresspeople who serve on committees that determine military funding. Many of those same members of Congress and their spouses also invest directly in weapons contractor stocks, so when they vote to send more bombs or send our loved ones to war, they profit personally. That’s why I introduced the Stop Politicians Profiting from War Act. | It’s shameful that my colleagues continue to funnel billions of U.S. tax dollars to the very same military contractors that many of them are invested in and taking campaign donations from. If passed, the Stop Politicians Profiting from War Act will prohibit members of Congress, their spouses, and their dependent children from having any financial interests in corporations that do business with the U.S. Department of Defense—including banning members from trading defense stocks. Members of Congress were elected to serve the public, not to serve their stock portfolios. They shouldn’t be able to use their positions of power to get rich while voting to pass more funding to bomb innocent civilians. Unfortunately, the weapons industry exerts incredible influence not just in our political system, but also in our education system. Many U.S. universities have boards of trustees that include military corporations’ executives, who have been pressuring schools to crack down on campus speech and suppress anti-war student efforts. I support the long-overdue dismantling of our country’s military-industrial complex so that we can finally put a stop to forever wars and reinvest into providing our communities with the resources they need and deserve. Thank you for continuing to demand better from our government. THE PIPELINE DECEPTION
They are Putting Us All at Risk–
Let’s Stop It Now
Dear Peter,
**I’m reaching out with an urgent message about a crisis unfolding in Iowa** —a crisis that threatens to spread nationwide. This is about government overreach into our land, our homes, and our lives.
Iowa is ground zero for a colossal scam: a scheme to force dangerous CO2 pipelines through the heartland of America, all under the guise of “green energy.” But let’s be clear—there’s nothing green about it.
Watch [_**The Pipeline Deception**_](https://www.mahanow.org/donate-em-pipeline?e=d33e868971601c1c714cfe0555abd394&utm_source=joinkennedy&utm_medium=email&utm_campaign=pipeline_10_20_24_un1&n=5) to see the truth behind this corporate land grab. You’ll hear from farmers and families on the front lines—people who’ve spent their lives nurturing their land, only to see it threatened by bureaucrats and billionaires.
[Watch Now](https://www.mahanow.org/donate-em-pipeline?e=d33e868971601c1c714cfe0555abd394&utm_source=joinkennedy&utm_medium=email&utm_campaign=pipeline_10_20_24_un1&n=6)
**Kamala Harris** cast the deciding vote to launch this nationwide scheme, and the Biden administration is pushing to expand it to nearly 90,000 miles of pipeline. They’re using eminent domain to seize private land, forcing CO2 pipelines onto farms and into our communities, regardless of the dangers.
**This is personal for me.** I’ve spent my life defending real environmental causes—our water, air, and soil. But this? It’s an environmental nightmare disguised as progress.
President Trump and I agree. We understand the urgent need to protect our land and our rights, and he’s committed to stopping this pipeline deception once and for all. **But to do that, we need to ensure he is elected, so we can have leaders who will defend American families, not corporate interests.**
[**Time is running out, and I need your support today. Will you stand with us against this dangerous pipeline invasion?**](https://www.mahanow.org/donate-em-pipeline?e=d33e868971601c1c714cfe0555abd394&utm_source=joinkennedy&utm_medium=email&utm_campaign=pipeline_10_20_24_un1&n=7)
[Donate Now](https://www.mahanow.org/donate-em-pipeline?e=d33e868971601c1c714cfe0555abd394&utm_source=joinkennedy&utm_medium=email&utm_campaign=pipeline_10_20_24_un1&n=8)
[**Your urgent donation**](https://www.mahanow.org/donate-em-pipeline?e=d33e868971601c1c714cfe0555abd394&utm_source=joinkennedy&utm_medium=email&utm_campaign=pipeline_10_20_24_un1&n=9) will help us stop these projects from tearing apart our communities. Every dollar counts. This fight goes beyond one pipeline—it’s about saving our nation from being sold off to the highest bidder.
Together, with President Trump, we can protect the America we love and secure it for generations to come.

clean_body: They are putting us all at risk. | | | | | | | THE PIPELINE DECEPTION They are Putting Us All at Risk– Let’s Stop It Now Dear Peter, I’m reaching out with an urgent message about a crisis unfolding in Iowa —a crisis that threatens to spread nationwide. This is about government overreach into our land, our homes, and our lives. Iowa is ground zero for a colossal scam: a scheme to force dangerous CO2 pipelines through the heartland of America, all under the guise of “green energy.” But let’s be clear—there’s nothing green about it. Watch to see the truth behind this corporate land grab. You’ll hear from farmers and families on the front lines—people who’ve spent their lives nurturing their land, only to see it threatened by bureaucrats and billionaires. Kamala Harris cast the deciding vote to launch this nationwide scheme, and the Biden administration is pushing to expand it to nearly 90,000 miles of pipeline. They’re using eminent domain to seize private land, forcing CO2 pipelines onto farms and into our communities, regardless of the dangers. This is personal for me. I’ve spent my life defending real environmental causes—our water, air, and soil. But this? It’s an environmental nightmare disguised as progress. President Trump and I agree. We understand the urgent need to protect our land and our rights, and he’s committed to stopping this pipeline deception once and for all. But to do that, we need to ensure he is elected, so we can have leaders who will defend American families, not corporate interests. will help us stop these projects from tearing apart our communities. Every dollar counts. This fight goes beyond one pipeline—it’s about saving our nation from being sold off to the highest bidder. Together, with President Trump, we can protect the America we love and secure it for generations to come. | | Robert F. I’m the grandson of Mexican immigrants, and my stepfather is an Army veteran. Like many Stocktonians, my family has overcome economic setbacks. # We Must Elect Kamala
# to Protect Women’s Rights!

Dear Friend,
Women’s rights are not a partisan issue—they are fundamental human rights. As a doctor, I trust our mothers, sisters, and daughters to make the best decisions about their bodies, in consultation with their healthcare providers. With the polls tightening, this election will be decided by who can engage the most voters in these final 15 days.
It’s more critical than ever that we do everything in our power to elect Kamala Harris and Democrats up and down the ballot. Only they will work to restore and protect essential freedoms, while right-wing Republicans and Trump continue to erode women’s rights and autonomy. Together, we can make a difference.
Please donate whatever you can today to ensure the campaign has the resources to reach every single voter. Additionally, please take a moment to watch and share the campaign ad below with your network to help spread the word about what’s at stake this election.
Thank you for your continued support!
Sincerely,
Dr. Asif Mahmood

Peter —
What we’ve been trying isn’t working. Plain and simple.
So, we’re lowering our ask to just $2.
Yes, just $2.
It might not sound like much, but if everyone who receives this email donates that $2 we’d blow our daily goals out of the water. We’d make up a ton of ground in what’s been an incredibly tough month.

But we do need people to chip in from time to time, when the situation is right and when they can afford to.

In Iraq, I had my Marines. In this campaign, I have you. I’ll fight it out on my own if I have to, but I’m not afraid to ask for help when I need it.
Peter — it’s Ruben. Personal note from me today.
It’s hard to shake the feeling that something’s wrong.
I’m not sure what it is, but you can always tell when something bad’s going to happen. I’ve got to tell you — right now, it feels like something’s off. I keep hearing about how this Senate race is locked up, that Kari Lake’s as good as defeated. I’m not seeing that.
You can’t escape the attack ads out here. Every time you turn on the TV they’re on. Trump’s got his eyes firmly fixed on Arizona, and Elon Musk is spending millions of his own money on get-out-the-vote efforts here. Kari Lake is still a threat, and don’t forget — she only lost by a few thousand votes last time.
And at the same time, our own fundraising... it’s not good, Peter. Without giving too much away here, we’re looking at big cuts because we’re not pulling in as much as we hoped we would. All of that adds up.
Marines have an old motto: “First to Fight.” In Iraq, we’d use special knocks to identify friend from foe when we were surrounded by insurgents. The comfort was knowing your friends were with you, that you had each other’s back.

Personal note from me today. It’s hard to shake the feeling that something’s wrong. I’m not sure what it is, but you can always tell when something bad’s going to happen. I’ve got to tell you — right now, it feels like something’s off. I keep hearing about how this Senate race is locked up, that Kari Lake’s as good as defeated. I’m not seeing that. You can’t escape the attack ads out here. Every time you turn on the TV they’re on. Trump’s got his eyes firmly fixed on Arizona, and Elon Musk is spending millions of his own money on get-out-the-vote efforts here. Kari Lake is still a threat, and don’t forget — she only lost by a few thousand votes last time. And at the same time, our own fundraising... it’s not good, Peter. Without giving too much away here, we’re looking at big cuts because we’re not pulling in as much as we hoped we would. All of that adds up. Marines have an old motto: “First to Fight.” In Iraq, we’d use special knocks to identify friend from foe when we were surrounded by insurgents. ### Hillary Pretends to be Gerald Ford

Hillary Scholten aired an ad this week claiming that her political hero is Gerald R. Ford! The version of Hillary that shows up in this ad does not bear the faintest resemblance to the Hillary Scholten who has shown up in Congress the past two years.
Working with Republicans? She has a 96% party-line voting record. Tough on immigration? She has voted against every border security bill. "Fiscal hero"? She supported $6 trillion in spending that led to the worst inflation in 40 years.
To paraphrase a famous political exchange, West Michigan knows Gerald Ford. Gerald Ford is a friend of ours, and you, ma'am, are no Gerald Ford.

clean_body: Have you heard what our opponents are saying? | | | Jon Tester and Sherrod Brown here. We’re in the middle of some pretty tight races in Ohio and Montana that you’ve probably heard about. But have you heard what our opponents are saying? 👇 Bernie Moreno, said it's "a little crazy " that women in Ohio are voting to defend reproductive rights. Tim Sheehy thinks young women who care about abortion access are “indoctrinated.” You read that right. They have once again shown us exactly who they are – extremists who will put their own out-of-touch agenda before the health and safety of women everywhere. Just take a look at what the talking heads have to say: And the difference between us could not be more clear: We know these decisions should be left between a woman and her doctor, and that no government official, least of all these two , should be forcing their way into the doctor’s office. We believe women should have the freedom to make their own health care decisions, while Bernie Moreno and Tim Sheehy think they should get the final say. If they get elected, they would be the deciding votes for a national abortion ban. We cannot let that happen. Friend of Life,

Planned Parenthood just came out with a new video that calls virginity "made up" and a "social construct."

The "educator" in the video tells young people: "It's time to throw away the notion of losing your virginity."

Instead of seeing it as "losing something," Planned Parenthood encourages impressionable teens to experiment sexually because "all of these myths around sex and virginity can be so hurtful and overwhelming."

Planned Parenthood is grooming the next generation for abortion. Promoting risky sexual practices to young people ultimately leads them to broken relationships and more children killed in the womb.

**Will you help fight back against Planned Parenthood 's anti-family, pro-death agenda? Planned Parenthood is the largest provider of sex education in America -- and they teach kids that gender is fluid, deviant sexual practices are normal and healthy, and anything goes, as long as it's consensual.

| Peter,

In case you missed it, Trump’s campaign is going after me for calling attention to his plan to fire federal workers – a direct threat to Virginia’s economy, Virginia’s federal employees, and thousands of Virginia jobs.

Under “Agenda 47” on his campaign website, he’s promising to bring back the reckless Schedule F executive order on “Day One.” He plans on firing public servants, those who have dedicated their lives to service — and then replacing them with Trump loyalists.

Virginia has more than 140,000 federal workers. Trump’s agenda would put the livelihoods of thousands of Virginians at risk.

The Virginians who have dedicated their careers to serving our country — including scientists, civilian DoD employees, law enforcement officers, infectious disease researchers, attorneys, and accountants — do not deserve this level of contempt.

After I called attention to this terrible idea, Trump’s campaign attacked me and tried to backpedal Agenda 47’s disastrous impacts on Virginia’s economy. Don’t be fooled – Virginians know what’s at stake this November.

subject: Agricutlure and America's Heartland
body:
MAGA has nothing to offer when it comes to fighting for farmers. Democrats in the Senate are proving that we are here for America's heartland.
| | | | | |
---
# Agriculture and America's Heartland
---
|
---
Defending the Senate is essential to protect America's heartland and ensure the continued support of farmers, agricultural scientists, and rural communities through sustainable policies. Democrats on the Agriculture Committee, like Senator Sherrod Brown, are fighting to prioritize agriculture and secure the future of rural America. Senator Brown, a senior member of the Senate Agriculture Committee, has introduced several bills aimed at supporting farmers and producers in Ohio and across the nation as part of the 2023 Farm Bill. His legislative package includes:

* **The Converting Our Waste Sustainably (COWS) Act** : Co-introduced with Senator Alex Padilla, this bipartisan bill establishes a manure management conservation program to improve water quality, reduce costs, and boost farmer profits while minimizing agricultural runoff. This legislation is endorsed by major organizations like the National Milk Producers Federation and the Environmental Working Group.

* **Supporting Urban and Innovative Farmers Act** : This bill aims to support urban and suburban farmers by increasing programmatic and research funding. It proposes reforms to improve technical assistance, enable cooperative agreements with community experts, and scale up composting and food waste initiatives.

* **The Enabling Farmers to Benefit from Processing Nutrition Programs Act** : Co-introduced with Senator Tina Smith, this bill simplifies the process for farmers to participate in federal nutrition programs, making it easier for families to use nutrition assistance benefits at farmers markets. It requires the Department of Agriculture to streamline application processes and provide necessary technology for benefit processing.

---
|
---
Additionally, Brown's bipartisan Local Farms and Food Act seeks to improve and update Farm Bill programs to facilitate local sales for farmers, building on previous legislation he helped pass. By defending the Senate, we can ensure that leaders like Senator Brown continue to advocate for policies that support farmers and rural communities, ensuring a sustainable future for America's heartland. Let's keep the progress rolling and protect the vital work being done for our farmers and agricultural economy.

Mom struggled with mental illness, and we often relied on government assistance to put food on the table. But thanks to the support and encouragement I received from my family and the Rockland community, I went from East Ramapo public schools to Harvard Law.

As someone who grew up poor, Black, and gay, I never saw anyone like me running for office, let alone the U.S. House of Representatives. In fact, someone like me had never been elected to Congress—whether from the Hudson Valley or anywhere in America.

But I decided to run anyway—and with the help of our grassroots, people-powered movement, we shocked Washington's political establishment and _won._

I was proud to be part of the most productive Congress in modern history. From rescuing the American economy during COVID to lowering prescription drug costs for seniors like my grandma and defending our democracy—we accomplished a lot for working families like my own.

But right now, Mike Lawler represents my district after winning by only 1,820 votes. A career political operative, Lawler will say anything you want to hear, but do whatever Mike Johnson and the extreme MAGA Republicans tell him to do. clean_body: I wanted to take a moment to share why I’m in this fight. Team, It's been a while since I shared a bit more about myself and why I'm in this race to flip New York's 17th District. I want to take a moment to tell you what this fight means to me, = I didn't have it easy growing up. My grandfather was a janitor, and my grandmother cleaned homes. Mom struggled with mental illness, and we often relied on government assistance to put food on the table. But thanks to the support and encouragement I received from my family and the Rockland community, I went from East Ramapo public schools to Harvard Law. As someone who grew up poor, Black, and gay, I never saw anyone like me running for office, let alone the U.S. House of Representatives. In fact, someone like me had never been elected to Congress—whether from the Hudson Valley or anywhere in America. But I decided to run anyway—and with the help of our grassroots, people-powered movement, we shocked Washington's political establishment and won. I was proud to be part of the most productive Congress in modern history. From rescuing the American economy during COVID to lowering prescription drug costs for seniors like my grandma and defending our democracy—we accomplished a lot for working families like my own. But right now, Mike Lawler represents my district after winning by only 1,820 votes. A career political operative, Lawler will say anything you want to hear, but do whatever Mike Johnson and the extreme MAGA Republicans tell him to do. He's slick like the Big Oil industry he used to lobby for. And he must be defeated in order for Democrats to retake the House. We have a real chance to make that happen. subject: Sunday News Digest: 10/20/2024
body:
Voting on judges this election and Heidi's letter to SOS Jena Griswold
| | | | [](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)
---
**October 20, 2024** **SUNDAY NEWS DIGEST** **By Heidi Ganahl**
| | Dear Rocky Mountain Voice Readers,
This November, Colorado voters will not only decide on important races and ballot measures but will also weigh in on the retention of judges across the state. So many of you have reached out for guidance on this topic in particular, and we want you to be able to make the most informed decision as possible.

In our most recent coverage, we’ve provided in-depth looks at the **[Colorado Supreme Court](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)** and the **[Colorado Court of Appeals](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)** judges who are up for retention this year. These articles dive into their records, performance evaluations, and key rulings that may influence your vote. We have another one coming this week, so keep your eyes peeled!
Speaking of your ballot, Colorado’s elections are far from secure. Rather than being a “gold standard” of integrity, they are a gilded mess of lies and half-measures.
Ten years ago, I handed off my “baby,” a $100 million pet care franchise built from scratch, so I could fight for the American dream I have been so blessed to live. I had seen how our politicians and government were tearing opportunities away from our children. Government was making it harder and harder to start and grow a business, raise our families, and live freely.
So, I went to work. First, I launched a non-profit to fight for justice in our court system: Moms Fight Back. Then, I was the last Republican to win a statewide race in Colorado as regent at the University of Colorado. For six years as a regent, I battled cancel culture, indoctrination and a growing administrative state on the front lines of higher education.
Then, I ran for governor, where I found myself at war with what I call “the machine,” a web of progressive billionaires and their sham non-profits, bought-and-paid for politicians and lapdog press. Through all of that, I gained a deep knowledge of how the sausage is made in our institutions, in our politics, in our media — things you can’t know unless you’ve been through that grinder...and it’s ugly.

I learned transparency and truth are the way out of this mess, which is why I launched Rocky Mountain Voice. We exist to hold bad actors accountable, to shine sunlight on their dark efforts, and to give others a way to get the truth out.

Two weeks ago, I held a press conference to announce the results of a two-year investigation backed by a dedicated team of researchers. We found gaps in our so-called “gold standard” elections. The “machine” does not like being called out, so it lashed out. Eight media stories coordinated in the last few days, with various politicians and their paid “experts” spouting prepared misinformation. They hoped their coordinated efforts would bury the truth.

This is not my first rodeo. I knew they would do this, so I made damn sure we checked, double-checked, and confirmed again every claim with industry experts that know far more than the bureaucrats and politicians claiming there is nothing to see. We want these problems fixed. I trust computer security experts to know how to do that, not politicians.

At the end of the day, it is up to you, the citizens of Colorado to decide what to believe. I am here to expose the “machine” and provide accurate, well-researched information so you can hold your government accountable. That is it, no other agenda. I am on a mission to get you the truth and force them into the sunshine.
**Read more about my adventure in election integrity and the issues I'm calling out on remote access[here](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.). **

In liberty, Heidi Ganahl

**[Durango School Board pauses decision to ban LGBTQ+, Black Lives Matter flags in classrooms](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)** [ROCKY MOUNTAIN VOICE](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.) In a room charged with emotion, the Durango School Board’s decision to revisit their flag policy left the community holding its breath. The Durango School Board met Oct. 15 to discuss the district’s recent choice to take down LGBTQ+ Pride and Black Lives Matter flags from classrooms.
**[Prop. 127’s ‘unintended consequences’ could be devastating, leaders in Northwest Colorado say](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)** [ROCKY MOUNTAIN VOICE](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.) Members of the Associated Governments of Northwestern Colorado (AGNC) were joined recently in a discussion of Proposition 127 by Gaspar Perricone, of the Wildlife Conservation Project and formerly a political advisor, legislative director to the Colorado Department of Natural Resources and regional director for Sen. Mark Udall.
**[‘This was a takeover’: CBZ Management no longer silent on violent TdA activity in Aurora](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)** [ROCKY MOUNTAIN VOICE](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.) A property management company, which has been vilified in Aurora as a slumlord, has begun to speak out through a new social media account. They are providing, in the words of Paul Harvey, the rest of the story.

|
---
**STATE**
**[FEC filings contradict Democrat Frisch’s claims that he doesn’t take corporate PAC money](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)** [ROCKY MOUNTAIN VOICE](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.) Adam Frisch, the Democratic nominee for Colorado’s 3rd Congressional District, has told his supporters in person, in debates, on social media and on national television, that he does not take corporate or PAC money.
**[Election volunteer, age 74, hospitalized following assault, others report sign theft, vandalism](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)** [ROCKY MOUNTAIN VOICE](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.) The political battleground in Colorado isn’t simply limited to choices on the ballot. Volunteers are finding the streets to be more than just a figurative battleground, as despite their efforts to promote a better tomorrow they are literally under attack today.
**[Hunting, ranching and 2nd Amendment groups rally voters to participate in election](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)** [ROCKY MOUNTAIN VOICE](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.) The Colorado Supreme Court, by 4-3, declined on Tuesday to address the high-profile issue of a Christian baker’s refusal to make a cake for a customer celebrating a gender transition, instead concluding the case was not properly filed in the first place.
**[Ex-ICE official John Fabbricatore warns Tren de Aragua growing faster than MS-13](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)** [FOX NEWS](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.) A former ICE field director is warning that a violent Venezuelan gang is more organized than the infamous MS-13, and is backing former President Donald Trump’s plan to stamp out the gang in Colorado and across the U.S.
**[Millions being spent on state legislative races in final weeks before Election Day](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)** [COLORADO POLITICS](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.) Outside groups hoping to influence voters about candidates running for seats in the state House and Senate are draining their bank accounts in the final weeks before the Nov. 5 election.
_**[READ MORE STATE NEWS](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)**_
|
---
**NATIONAL**
**[Gallup poll finds majority of Americans feel worse off now than four years ago under Trump](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)** [BREITBART](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.) A majority of Americans (52 percent) feel worse off today than four years ago under former President Donald Trump, Gallup polling found Friday.

**[Trump vows to ‘end all sanctuary cities’ at ‘Faulkner Focus’ town hall with female voters](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)** [FOX NEWS](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.) Former President Donald Trump vowed to end sanctuary cities and restore “normalcy” as he took questions from female voters concerned about a variety of issues ahead of Election Day, including the economy, crime and abortion.
**[Kamala Harris urges black men to vote for her to legalize marijuana — despite convicting 1,900 as DA](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)** [NEW YORK POST](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.) Vice President Kamala Harris urged black men to back her presidential candidacy Tuesday by pledging to legalize marijuana — despite overseeing more than 1,900 marijuana convictions as San Francisco district attorney between 2004 and 2011.
**[US boots hit ground in Israel as threat from Iran looms](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)** [THE DAILY CALLER](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.) U.S. servicemembers arrived in Israel on Monday amid the country’s chaotic multifront war with various actors in the region, and more troops will arrive soon, the Pentagon said on Tuesday.
**[Kamala Harris’ career of releasing murderers and drug dealers proves she won’t be ‘tough on crime’](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)** [THE FEDERALIST](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.) Harris’ disastrous policies as the San Francisco district attorney increased crime, freed murderers, and cost lives. Kamala Devi Harris often points to her time as a prosecutor to prove she is a tough-on-crime champion of public safety.
**[READ MORE NATIONAL NEWS](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)**
|
---
**LOCAL**
**[Homeless are ‘dumpster diving’ and rural police chief wants trespassing law to stop it](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)** [ROCKY MOUNTAIN VOICE](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.) A new measure could be added to Fort Morgan’s criminal code in response to a homeless man who may nearly have been killed as a result of living inside a dumpster on trash pickup day.

**[On Western Slope, opioid crisis continues and sheriffs say it is leading to mental health, crime](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)** [ROCKY MOUNTAIN VOICE](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.) Mesa County Sheriff Todd Rowell and Delta County Sheriff Mark Taylor have had a constant battle fighting the opioid crisis in their counties since 2017, when it first started impacting western Colorado.
**[In Larimer County, sheriff and DA at odds over claims DA doesn’t properly prosecute child predators](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)** [CBS COLORADO](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.) Two of Larimer County’s top law enforcement officials are at odds over how the Colorado county’s district attorney’s office is prosecuting suspects of some crimes.
**[Taxpayer dollars used to buy campaign signs for Englewood bond measure](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)** [COLORADO POLITICS](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.) The City of Englewood is facing criticism over a possible campaign law violation after using taxpayer dollars to purchase lawn signs advocating for the passage of one of its ballot measures.

**_[READ MORE LOCAL NEWS](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)_**
|

**COMMENTARY**
**[Ganahl: Dear Jena, let’s get real about remote access](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)** [ROCKY MOUNTAIN VOICE](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.) _Colorado’s elections are far from secure. Rather than being a “gold standard” of integrity, they are a gilded mess of lies and half-measures._
**[Sloan: Do we all – Democrats and Republicans – like nuclear now?](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)** [ROCKY MOUNTAIN VOICE](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.) _We have not been afforded any authoritative glimpses into the proposed energy policies of either Mr. Trump or Ms. Harris, leaving us with only the conventional jousting positions with which to make comparisons._
**[Ganahl: Retail rescue outed by a rabies outbreak](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)** [ROCKY MOUNTAIN VOICE](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.) _Colorado’s animal rescue system has long been regarded as a national leader, rescuing tens of thousands of pets from outside the state each year to meet the growing demand for furry companions._
**[Devotional: Don’t be a rebel. Engage in the process and vote.](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)** [ROCKY MOUNTAIN VOICE](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.) _As we look ahead to our country’s future, it’s important to recognize the significant role that the government plays in shaping it. While there may be differing perspectives on this role, it’s undeniable that the government holds substantial influence over our collective destiny._
**[Daniel: Leave wildlife management to CPW, vote no on Prop. 127](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)** [ROCKY MOUNTAIN VOICE](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.) _Proposition 127, currently under debate in Colorado, aims to impose a blanket ban on hunting mountain lions, bobcats and lynx. However, it is important to clarify some of the misleading claims surrounding this measure._

Survival Ops here... and I have something exciting to share with you.

I'm really pumped about this because it's been a work in progress for months and I think we've finally nailed it!

So enough giddyness... are you ready to {tackle your next adventure head-on}?

Yea?

Well let me introduce you to the [{Tactical GO Bag}](https://links.gunowner-news.com/a/1537/click/18851/6374453/16a026695bbc30e2ff967c3b6400186db767e9a3/05a3d059937cd52d62f719f007773d843a6323b2) \- your new, feature-packed, best friend who is ready to kick it with you on any outdoor escapade.

This isn’t just some run-of-mill backpack; it really is a game changer... because a few recognized survival experts put their minds together and helped develop this {incredible bag}.

They designed it to withstand the rigors of hiking, camping, fishing and traveling.

You can literally kick its ass and it'll never skip a beat.

That alone makes it hella special.

And one of my favorite features... the multi-military-style compartments that this bag has that will help you stay organized like a true pro.

All those compartments combined gives you a whopping 42 liters of storage. You can cram it full and still have room for more.

Also, don't forget to look inside... you'll find some interior storage surprises too!

And of course the ventilated mesh padding on the back and shoulder straps means you won’t feel weighted down - ever.

Throw in an adjustable chest strap as well to provide even more support, making long hikes or trips a breeze.

So there you have it...

Whether you need a[ {bug-out bag, a three-day assault pack, or a sleek laptop day pack}](https://links.gunowner-news.com/a/1537/click/18851/6374453/16a026695bbc30e2ff967c3b6400186db767e9a3/05a3d059937cd52d62f719f007773d843a6323b2), this bag adapts and conforms to your lifestyle while keeping you COMFORTABLE.

It’s perfect for both urban adventures and off-grid excursions.

And currently there is an unbeatable deal going on.

You can test one out for ZERO cost. You just pay shipping.

But time is ticking.

[{Hurry before the offers ends!}](https://links.gunowner-news.com/a/1537/click/18851/6374453/16a026695bbc30e2ff967c3b6400186db767e9a3/05a3d059937cd52d62f719f007773d843a6323b2)

I won my first Senate race by just 3,562 votes—and this one could be even closer. That’s why it's such bad news that **our fundraising has taken a nosedive in the past 48 hours.**

**Let's do some digging on the Pro-RCV group here in Alaska. Disclaimer from their most recent newsletter.****The Pro-RCV group appears to be the “Dark Money” they were so worried about, Arabella Advisors and 1630 Fund are about as “Dark Money” as “Dark Money” gets.**_**Their new Incorporation is their top donor.**__**Then "Article Four from Virginia"**__**Then "1630 Fund in Washington D.C."**_

This is who is funding the [#RankedChoiceVoting](https://f69e.engage.squarespace-mail.com/r?m=671560c19c05604641a6842d&u=https%3A%2F%2Ftwitter.com%2Fhashtag%2FRankedChoiceVoting%3Fsrc%3Dhashtag_click&w=636d98a80d1d302f275cb244&c=b_67155f994628b3696e33b865&l=en-US&s=oZplloW7KghpAmek-RtoO3-iuh0%3D) group in Alaska 1630 Fund Swiss billionaire whose personal goal is to “(re)interpret the American Constitution in the light of progressive politics” has donated hundreds of millions of dollars to a left-wing group that is dumping millions into state ballot initiatives, a new report from Americans for Public Trust (APT) revealed. Hansjörg Wyss, through his Berger Action Fund, has donated $243 million to the Sixteen Thirty Fund, which “uses its war chest ... to support massive get-out-the-vote drives, issue advocacy campaigns bolstering President Biden’s agenda, liberal pet projects from abortion to immigration, and attack ads against Republican lawmakers,”
---
Swiss billionaire Hansjörg Wyss has been channeling substantial funds into American state ballot initiatives through the 1630 Fund aka Sixteen Thirty Fund, a progressive advocacy group.As reported by Americans for Public Trust, Wyss’s donations, which total around $243 million to the group, have been instrumental in influencing policies across various states, with a significant focus on Michigan. Since 2017, nearly $34 million has been funneled into Michigan to, among other goals, "rewrite the state’s election laws." This massive infusion of cash aims at bolstering liberal causes from immigration to abortion and enhancing Democratic voter turnout. Such activities have sparked controversy and legislative responses aimed at curbing foreign influence in American electoral processes.https://thefederalist.com/2024/04/18/dark-money-group-backed-by-foreign-billionaire-has-dumped-100-million-into-state-ballot-initiatives/1630 Fund is currently funding multiple ballot initiatives in Alaska, including Alaskans For Better Elections AKBE who brought Ranked Choice Voting to Alaska. Also including the recent push for a higher minimum wage. At some point, one must question when the regulators and government officials, elected to safeguard citizens, become tools manipulated by these malicious actors to act against the citizens they are meant to protect.(e.g. we have been attacked 4 times so far 3 times using state offices, we have been spied on, harassed, and our reputations damaged nationwide all because we were trying to address an election system we didn't feel was a good fit for Alaska)I hope you take this threat to your State Seriously, they are incredibly well funded and they are hell bent on making changes to the State of Alaska. This is one of those cases of too big to fail, where you will attack Alaskans and regular people, but applying these rules to a Swiss Billionaire is outside your job and expectations. As a citizen it saddens me to learn that millionaires and billionaires have more influence on a state and the way the state operates than the people who live here.Phil IzonPer State Statutes:**Sec. 15.13.068. subject: Help me fight back against the barrage of personal attacks and threats from Trump
disclaimer_text: Paid for by Mark Takano For Congress P
body:
| Peter —

In a truly weird turn of events, Donald Trump came to Coachella, California, for a campaign rally with just weeks to go in this election.

And instead of focusing his speech on telling people what he’d do as president, he spent a lot of his time attacking me in terms we only hear from dictators.

Here’s just a small sample of what he said about yours truly: **_“Sleazebag”
“Major lowlife”
“A bad person, a sick person”_** Yet again, this is just more of the same attacks he throws at me every chance he gets. Whether he’s at a rally in Iowa, Pennsylvania, Florida, or right here in California, he just can’t stop thinking about me.

But that’s not all he said. He attacked California’s election integrity, setting up future claims of election fraud when he inevitably loses our state.

Even worse, in an act of political retribution, he said as president he would withhold aid to California in its effort to fight wildfires. Who does that?

| **ABOUT NELLA**
**New Mexico is Nella Domenici’s home. She was born in Albuquerque and lived for most of her childhood in a home near the intersection of Lomas and Monroe with her seven siblings, and her parents - Pete and Nancy Domenici. Nella began her education at Our Lady of Fatima, where she learned the values she holds today. Nella is a proud third-generation New Mexican, devoted mother of two, step-mom of four, and the wife of a Navy Veteran. Nella’s family’s roots run deep in New Mexico and she and her husband Pat enjoy their family home in New Mexico that they have owned for nearly twenty years.

Like most New Mexicans, Nella Domenici understands the importance of hard work. She waited tables to help pay for her undergraduate degree from Georgetown University, and worked her way through night school at Georgetown Law while holding down a full time job. She then graduated from Harvard Business School as a Baker Scholar, top 5% of the class, while 9 months pregnant.

Nella began her career at the bottom and worked her way up through the complex finance world, eventually serving as CFO for one of the world’s largest, most successful investment firms. In her career, Nella advised, invested in, grew, and led many companies, and served on public company boards. The industries she has worked in are vast and include areas such as health care, AI, food service, lodging, commercial real estate, mortgage lending, and consumer products. These companies have ranged from small family-owned businesses, to rapidly growing venture backed enterprises, to a Fortune 200 company. Several of these have been headquartered in New Mexico. Collectively, the companies Nella has been heavily involved with have employed thousands of Americans.

Like her father and mother, Nella has been a warrior for those who most need an advocate: for women competing in academics or business, for families dealing with mental illness, and for those without access to quality healthcare or education. **

Fellow Patriot, We're in a moment of national reflection. And for many Americans, it's a question of how we reset and reshape our culture, institutions, and daily lives--_for the better_. **Fellow Patriot, over the past year, I wrote my new book,****_Right Wing Revolution,_****as a guide for a return to an America where ...**
* We are united with a national spirit of love of country and belief in American Greatness.

* We have a free society, secure borders, and respect for our Constitution.

* We have rapidly increasing church attendance and a nationwide spiritual renewal.

* We trust our neighbors, feel safe in our communities, and don't have to lock our doors at night.

* We bring up the next generation to love our country, to live with integrity and strong morals, and to champion a bright future for all Americans.

Hi folks — With Election Day less than three weeks away, I can only assume your inbox is full of requests from campaigns like mine trying to earn your support. _That’s how my inbox looks!_
Chances are, you didn’t wake up this morning thinking, _“today’s the day I’m going to donate to Tammy’s reelection campaign!”_ But I hope you’ll give me a moment to explain why you should.
My Republican opponent, Eric Hovde, and right-wing super PACs have engaged in a massive ad blitz to tear me down and flip my seat red — **they’ve already spent $68 million on the airwaves,** and there’s more where that came from.
A national abortion ban, cuts to Social Security and Medicare, a repeal of the Affordable Care Act, and so much more will be on the table if Republicans flip this seat red. And trust me when I tell you, friend, _they sure think that they can._
It’s why Mitch McConnell’s super PAC just dropped $24 million worth of ads in Wisconsin — **they wouldn’t spend that kind of money this close to the election unless they were confident Hovde could win.**
With consecutive polls showing a tightening statistically-tied race and elections experts moving our race to a “Toss Up,” it’s more urgent than ever before that we respond to the Republican attacks I’m facing with ads of our own to set the record straight.
But these ad reservations don’t come cheap, and I don’t have the same luxury of dipping into a personal fortune to fund this campaign like my megamillionaire opponent can. That’s why I’m counting on your grassroots support today.
[**So, friend, can I count on you to split a donation of $10 or more between my campaign and Jeanne Shaheen's to help us fight back against Hovde, McConnell, and the right-wing super PACs trying to buy Wisconsin’s Senate seat? subject: WARNING: Florida's biggest snake FOUND
disclaimer_text: Paid for by Gillibrand for Senate
body:
There's a snake slithering on the Senate floor ...
| | |
---

| | | Dear Fellow Patriot,

EARLY VOTING STARTS TOMORROW! Let's take CD7 back!

Lizzie Fletcher believes in an _**open**_ border and that you and your families should foot the bill for every illegal who has come into the country under the Biden-Harris administration!

She is no moderate. She votes lock-step with AOC and other party operatives, putting radical, Anti-American agendas above common sense.

We cannot AFFORD Lizzie Fletcher!

---
|
---
| **HERE'S WHY:** Lizzie[ voted](https://carolinekaneforcongress.us11.list-manage.com/track/click?u=717a41e4858de35bfe1b5917d&id=aade5696b3&e=522547b974 "https://clerk.house.gov/Votes/202496") against the Secure Border Act.

Lizzie [voted](https://carolinekaneforcongress.us11.list-manage.com/track/click?u=717a41e4858de35bfe1b5917d&id=3dcbdbf155&e=522547b974 "https://clerk.house.gov/Votes/2023225") against the POLICE ACT which would immediately deport any illegal immigrant who assaults a Police Officer.

Lizzie [voted](https://carolinekaneforcongress.us11.list-manage.com/track/click?u=717a41e4858de35bfe1b5917d&id=139b0f4d66&e=522547b974 "https://clerk.house.gov/Votes/2024345") against the SAVE Act which would prevent illegal immigrants from voting in US Elections.

Lizzie [voted](https://carolinekaneforcongress.us11.list-manage.com/track/click?u=717a41e4858de35bfe1b5917d&id=98ba73ccf2&e=522547b974)[ ](https://carolinekaneforcongress.us11.list-manage.com/track/click?u=717a41e4858de35bfe1b5917d&id=30419e4f1e&e=522547b974)against the Parental Bill of Rights (H.R. 5), which would have protected parental authority in schools and ensured parents were notified about critical decisions related to their child's health and safety.

Lizzie [voted](https://carolinekaneforcongress.us11.list-manage.com/track/click?u=717a41e4858de35bfe1b5917d&id=def8ae13bb&e=522547b974) against Restoring Energy Dominance and [stood](https://carolinekaneforcongress.us11.list-manage.com/track/click?u=717a41e4858de35bfe1b5917d&id=9436e4ceed&e=522547b974) by Biden's harmful, anti-American energy policies while representing us, the home of Houston's Energy Corridor.

Lizzie [voted](https://carolinekaneforcongress.us11.list-manage.com/track/click?u=717a41e4858de35bfe1b5917d&id=aa3073baff&e=522547b974) for the Build Back Better Act, which would have raised taxes by $1 trillion on American workers and businesses.

Lizzie [voted](https://carolinekaneforcongress.us11.list-manage.com/track/click?u=717a41e4858de35bfe1b5917d&id=1b1eec0ac4&e=522547b974) for the Inflation Reduction Act (The Green New Deal or Climate Justice Act), which paved the way for $20 billion in tax increases on those making less than $400k and funded 87,000 new IRS agents to target middle-class families, which is _**90% of us!**_

| | |

Friend, I know I'm sending you a lot of incredibly urgent emails about my race in Nevada these days. **But today, I want to take a step back and share the story of how I first got involved in politics.**
In 2016, while I was serving as the president of my synagogue in Nevada, Senator Harry Reid recruited me to run in a competitive House race to help flip a red seat blue. Looking back, it's incredibly fitting that _this_ was my entry point to public service – because my Judaism helps guide much of my work in the Senate today.
In fact, my decision to say "yes" and run for public office in the first place was guided by the Jewish principle of Tikkun Olam – which means to leave the world a better place than how we found it.
Now, as the third Jewish woman and only former synagogue president in Senate history, I'm proud to serve Nevada and our country. And I'm as committed as ever to keep fighting to better this world and make positive change happen. **But I need your help.**
_**The Cook Political Report**_**has been calling Nevada the “most perilous" battleground for Democrats. And as we enter the final stretch of this race, polls now show me losing crucial ground to my extreme MAGA opponent – right as**** early voting is getting started.**

name: Adam Schiff
subject: Trump attacked me at a rally. Again.
disclaimer_text: Paid for by ECU Non-federal
body:
| [ ](https://act.fightforreform.org/go/26910?t=1&akid=22348%2E4449941%2EJPFfpI)
---
Team — During a rambling speech at a campaign rally in Scranton, Pennsylvania, Donald Trump attacked wind power, said he doesn’t care about being nice to women, bragged about getting along well with North Korea’s dictator, Kim Jong Un, and _so much more_ for over 80 minutes.

**And he came after me, too, in his unhinged attack.** [**Before I get into the details of Trump’s attack, I’m hoping you can pitch in a split donation between Fight for Reform to elect state and local Democrats and my campaign for Senate — because the last place Donald Trump wants me to be is in the U.S. Senate, where I will hold him and his enablers accountable every single day.**](https://act.fightforreform.org/go/55278?t=7&akid=22348%2E4449941%2EJPFfpI) [ ](https://act.fightforreform.org/go/55278?t=8&akid=22348%2E4449941%2EJPFfpI) _“You take a child who is 5 years old, he knows more about Russia than my son, and yet**Adam Shifty Schiff** came out of an Intelligence Committee hearing and said ‘Donald Trump Jr. will go to jail for what he did with Russia’... **It was a scam!**... He’s a **sleazebag** that goes out and says my son will go to jail on a con job he made up with Hillary and some of the others. **How bad do you have to be?**... But we’re going to defeat these radical left lunatics.”_ Team, there he goes again. Lie after lie. And the worst part is the former president might actually believe them.

As chair of the House Intelligence Committee, I investigated Donald Trump and revealed he (and Don Jr.) sought Russian help in his election, received it, lied about it, and sought to cover it up.

Trump hopes his lies will be a distraction. His insults are meant to take away from the truth — that Donald Trump and his campaign twice sought foreign help to win the presidency.

And when he broke U.S. law by withholding critical aid to Ukraine to extort their leader into helping his campaign, I led his impeachment and secured the first bipartisan Senate vote to convict a U.S. president. He has never let go of that humiliation, so he attacks me. Relentlessly.

He knows that no one has been more effective at holding him accountable for his lies and misdeeds, and nothing infuriates his supporters more than the reminder of how I stood up to him.

In the Senate, I’ll keep fighting his assaults on our democracy and hold his biggest enablers accountable.

His obsession is the highest compliment — it means I’m doing my job. [**I’ll always stand up to Trump and anyone who attacks our democracy. But for us to respond before their vicious lies take hold, I need your support. Please, I need you to pitch in a split donation between my campaign and Fight for Reform to elect state and local Democrats. We have less than 3 weeks left to defeat Trump and the MAGA movement.**](https://act.fightforreform.org/go/55278?t=9&akid=22348%2E4449941%2EJPFfpI) If you've saved your payment information with ActBlue Express, your split donation between Fight for Reform and Adam Schiff will go through immediately: | [CONTRIBUTE $10 »](https://act.fightforreform.org/go/55279?t=10&akid=22348%2E4449941%2EJPFfpI)
---
[CONTRIBUTE $25 »](https://act.fightforreform.org/go/55280?t=11&akid=22348%2E4449941%2EJPFfpI)
[CONTRIBUTE $50 »](https://act.fightforreform.org/go/55281?t=12&akid=22348%2E4449941%2EJPFfpI)
[CONTRIBUTE $100 »](https://act.fightforreform.org/go/55282?t=13&akid=22348%2E4449941%2EJPFfpI)
[Or a custom donation »](https://act.fightforreform.org/go/55278?t=14&akid=22348%2E4449941%2EJPFfpI)
I’m counting on you.

Thanks,

Adam

If the GOP succeeds in flipping Pennsylvania red, they’ll almost certainly regain control of both the Senate _and_ the White House, threatening everything from voting rights to women’s rights to the fight against climate change.
That’s why outside interest groups are spending upwards of $150 million to defeat Bob. subject: What a difference between then and now
body:
[https://prod.cdn.everyaction.com/images/van/NGP/NGP33/1/100067/images/LOGO.jpg]
Friends,
Everywhere I go, in every county across this district, I’ve got people coming up excited to tell me: “Tamie, I voted for you!”
It's so exciting and encouraging!
When I started this journey three and a half years ago, I never imagined we’d be where we are today.
I’m not a politician. I’m just a regular person, a middle-class mom, and a small business owner, fed up with the rise in hate and the constant chaos.
So I stepped up. Now, we’ve made history. We've built the strongest campaign Jim Jordan has ever faced – and he knows it.
We’ve got ads, billboards, canvassers, and more in play – but there is more we need to do before Election Day so every second, every dollar counts. Will you chip in $25, $50, $100, $1,000, $2,500, or max out at $3,300 right now to help us FIRE Jim Jordan and unseat the most dangerous man in Congress? [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/tamie-wilson-for-us-c2g?refcode=20241020_then_and_now_link1]
We’ve made national headlines for how powerful this movement has become.
Our campaign has raised more than $2 million – the most any challenger has ever raised to take on Jordan.
And just a few days ago, Jim Jordan himself admitted in an interview that he could lose this election.
You read that right – he knows we’ve got him on the run.
This is a special moment in history.
I’m living proof that when regular, hardworking Americans can challenge even the most entrenched, dangerous figures in Washington.
Furthermore, WHEN WE FIGHT - WE WIN!
Jim Jordan, a man who’s spent 17 years in Congress without authoring a single bill that’s become law, is now facing his toughest battle yet.
Together, we’re doing what no one thought was possible – and we’re doing it because people are fed up with the hate, the fear, and the lies Jordan represents.
But we’re not done yet.
Will you rush a contribution now to help us reach every last voter? We’ve got Jordan on the ropes, and with your help, we can send him packing for good. [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/tamie-wilson-for-us-c2g?refcode=20241020_then_and_now_link2]
This is the most important congressional race in the country, and together, we can prove that regular, hardworking people who want to make life better for families can win against extremists like Jim Jordan.
Let’s keep pushing forward and make history by ending his reign of dysfunction.
Working for US,
Tamie Wilson

| **ABOUT NELLA**
**New Mexico is Nella Domenici’s home. She was born in Albuquerque and lived for most of her childhood in a home near the intersection of Lomas and Monroe with her seven siblings, and her parents - Pete and Nancy Domenici. Nella began her education at Our Lady of Fatima, where she learned the values she holds today. Nella is a proud third-generation New Mexican, devoted mother of two, step-mom of four, and the wife of a Navy Veteran. Nella’s family’s roots run deep in New Mexico and she and her husband Pat enjoy their family home in New Mexico that they have owned for nearly twenty years.

Like most New Mexicans, Nella Domenici understands the importance of hard work. She waited tables to help pay for her undergraduate degree from Georgetown University, and worked her way through night school at Georgetown Law while holding down a full time job. She then graduated from Harvard Business School as a Baker Scholar, top 5% of the class, while 9 months pregnant.

Nella began her career at the bottom and worked her way up through the complex finance world, eventually serving as CFO for one of the world’s largest, most successful investment firms. In her career, Nella advised, invested in, grew, and led many companies, and served on public company boards. The industries she has worked in are vast and include areas such as health care, AI, food service, lodging, commercial real estate, mortgage lending, and consumer products. These companies have ranged from small family-owned businesses, to rapidly growing venture backed enterprises, to a Fortune 200 company. Several of these have been headquartered in New Mexico. Collectively, the companies Nella has been heavily involved with have employed thousands of Americans.

Like her father and mother, Nella has been a warrior for those who most need an advocate: for women competing in academics or business, for families dealing with mental illness, and for those without access to quality healthcare or education. **
